new_roles.title: VP Manufacturing & Production
new_roles.description:
About Us

 

Skydweller Aero Inc. is a transatlantic, cutting-edge aerospace company developing solar-powered aircraft solutions capable of perpetual flight while carrying heavy and powerful payloads. Building on technology from the longest continuous renewably powered flight program in history, this fast-growing company is creating a new class of unmanned aircraft. It combines the persistence of geosynchronous satellites with the sensing capabilities and flexibility of a large airborne platform. Skydweller Aero Inc. has its global and US headquarters in Oklahoma City, with European operations headquartered in Spain.

Role Summary

 

As Skydweller prepares to move from development toward aircraft production, we are looking for an experienced manufacturing executive to build and lead our production organization. This role is based in **Oklahoma City, OK** and reports to the Chief Operating Officer.

The Vice President, Manufacturing & Production will own all aircraft production operations: final assembly, systems integration, avionics installation, production testing, factory operations and aircraft delivery. You will lead the organization as we scale from prototype and low-rate initial production into sustained manufacturing.

We are looking for a hands-on aerospace manufacturing leader with a proven track record of building production organizations, improving factory performance and delivering complex aircraft in FAA-regulated environments.

**Why join:** Most manufacturing leadership roles optimize an existing production system. This one builds it. You will establish the manufacturing organization, develop the factory workforce, and scale production of one of the most ambitious autonomous aircraft programs in aerospace.

Responsibilities

 

**Production leadership**

 

* Lead all aircraft production and manufacturing operations.
* Drive safe, efficient and repeatable aircraft production.
* Build and lead a high-performing manufacturing organization, with clear management systems, metrics and operating rhythms.
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, quality and continuous improvement.

 

**Assembly and integration**

* Oversee final assembly, systems and electrical integration, avionics installation and aircraft completion.
* Ensure aircraft are built to engineering, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Drive production readiness and resolve manufacturing constraints and bottlenecks.

 

**Production planning and execution**

* Own execution of the Master Production Schedule.
* Lead production planning, labor allocation and resource management.
* Set capacity plans that support production-rate growth.
* Monitor factory performance and drive throughput, productivity and efficiency improvements.

 

**Production testing and acceptance**

* Lead production acceptance testing and ground test operations.
* Coordinate production readiness with Engineering, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.
* Ensure aircraft move smoothly from production through acceptance and delivery.

 

**Regulatory compliance and quality**

* Ensure compliance with FAA Part 21 production requirements and the company quality management system.
* Maintain production configuration control and manufacturing documentation discipline.
* Support internal, regulatory and customer audits and certification activities.
* Partner with Quality leadership to improve first-pass yield.

 

**Growth and scale-up**

* Develop the manufacturing infrastructure, facilities and staffing plans needed for higher production rates.
* Implement lean manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives.

 

**People leadership**

* Recruit, develop and mentor production leaders and technical staff.
* Establish workforce development and skills-training programs.
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.

 

Success Measures

You will be measured on aircraft delivery performance, production schedule attainment, factory throughput, labor productivity, manufacturing cost, quality and first-pass yield, safety, production-rate readiness, and workforce development and retention.

Required Qualifications

 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Aerospace, Operations or a related technical field.
* 15+ years of progressive aerospace manufacturing leadership experience, including 10+ years leading production organizations in aerospace, defense, aviation or another highly regulated industry.
* Proven experience scaling manufacturing from development, prototype or low-rate production to higher-rate production.
* Experience leading large, cross-functional manufacturing organizations.
* Strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, quality systems and manufacturing performance metrics.
* Experience implementing lean manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives.
* Excellent communication, leadership and organizational skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business or Operations.
* FAA Part 21 production experience and experience with certified aircraft manufacturing programs.
* Experience leading final assembly and aircraft integration organizations.
* Experience supporting aircraft certification, conformity and production acceptance.
* Background in autonomous aircraft, UAS, defense aviation or advanced aerospace systems.
* Experience building greenfield or fast-growing manufacturing operations.
* Composite aircraft manufacturing experience.
* AS9100 quality system experience.

 

Please Note

 

* **Security clearance requirement:** This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required.

* **One application per candidate:** Please apply to one position only. If you are interested in other open roles, list them in the Notes section of your application.

* **Check your spam folder:** We use BambooHR, a third-party recruiting platform, to contact candidates. Please check your spam or junk folder regularly so you don't miss our messages.

* **English CV:** Please submit your resume in English.

 

Company Benefits

 

* **Health insurance:** Medical, dental and vision coverage for all full-time employees.
* **401(k) retirement plan:** A 401(k) plan to help you save for retirement.
* **Paid time off:** Vacation, sick leave and personal days.
* **Flexible schedules:** Flexible working hours to support a healthy work-life balance.
* **Professional development:** Training, education and tuition reimbursement opportunities to help you grow your skills and career.
* **Wellness programs:** Programs that support healthy living, which may include gym memberships, nutrition counseling or stress-management classes.
* **Stock options:** Full-time employees may be eligible for stock options after one year of service.
* **Performance bonuses:** Bonus opportunities that reward individual and company performance.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Skydweller Aero Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law, subject to the security clearance requirements above.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at [email].

Privacy and AI

By applying, you acknowledge our [Applicant Privacy Notice]. We may use AI-assisted tools to help review applications, but all hiring decisions are made by people.

new_roles.title: Deputy Director of Launch Production (Job ID:4696)
new_roles.description:
**Deputy Director of Launch Production**

**Purpose:**

* Valkyrie Enterprises is seeking a **Deputy Director of Launch Production** in **Huntsville, AL**, to oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of launch production programs in support of Department of War (DoW) customers.

**Job Description:**

* Manage all aspects of launch production programs, including technical performance, cost, schedule, contract requirements, and program deliverables.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, and support services, to ensure successful program execution.
* Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, budgets, and performance metrics to ensure program milestones and customer requirements are met.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing regular updates on program performance, schedules, risks, and deliverables.
* Monitor program performance, identify potential risks, and implement corrective actions to ensure successful execution within established budgets and timelines.
* Support the development and implementation of a 5-year strategic plan for launcher and launch services across the DoW, including ground-based, sea-based, and air-launched capabilities.
* Support business development and capture activities, including identifying new opportunities, developing proposals, and supporting FAR-based contracts, Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs), and task orders.
* Manage program financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and profitability.
* Work closely with company leadership to align program objectives with customer requirements and organizational goals.
* Provide leadership and oversight of program personnel, including staffing, resource planning, and team performance.

**Qualifications:**

* Must have a Bachelor's Degree in a STEM field and at least 20 years of relevant experience supporting DoW programs or projects.
* Must have demonstrated experience managing complex defense programs, including cost, schedule, technical performance, and contract execution.
* Must have experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating technical, manufacturing, and production activities.
* Must have experience managing program budgets, financial performance, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Must have experience executing government contracts, including FAR-based contracts, OTAs, and task orders.
* Must have demonstrated experience managing customer relationships and ensuring successful delivery of contractual requirements.
* Must have experience supporting business development, proposal development, and capture efforts.
* Must have demonstrated leadership experience, including personnel management, staffing, and organizational growth.
* Must be a self-starter with strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Must have strong oral and written communication skills.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
* Experience managing missile, launcher, or defense production programs preferred.
* Top Secret/SCI security clearance preferred.

**Security Requirements:**

* Must have an Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain the clearance.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Travel – 25%.
* If position requires travel by domestic flight or access to secure federal facilities/military bases, candidate must be able to obtain (by start of position) and maintain appropriate identification credentials, such as REAL ID. (More information regarding REAL ID can be found: https://www.dhs.gov/real-id)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
* Able to sit and work on a computer for long periods of time.
* Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another.
* Communicating with others to exchange information.
* Light work that includes moving objects up to 20 pounds.

**Pre-Employment Requirements:**

Any offer of employment with Valkyrie Enterprises is contingent upon the successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements. Depending on the position, these may include a criminal background investigation, employment and education verification, pre-employment drug screening, driving record review, security clearance eligibility, government installation access, and any other customer or contract-specific requirements. Failure to successfully meet any required pre-employment condition may result in the withdrawal of the contingent offer of employment.

**Valkyrie strictly adheres to a policy of equal employment opportunity. This policy is based on Valkyrie’s commitment to hire and retain qualified employees consistent with position requirements; and to seek, employ, promote and treat all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental disability, age, military status or protected veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition, genetic information or sexual orientation or other protected characteristics.**

Additionally, Valkyrie Enterprises provides a variety of benefits to eligible employees to support your best health, wellness, and future, to include medical/dental/vision options, company paid life and disability insurances, 401k with match, education reimbursement, as well as company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**U C Coatings Director of Operations**

**Reports to** President

**Location** Based at a U-C Coatings facility; Buffalo, NY or Kenosha, WI preferred

**Travel** Approximately 25-35%, including regular travel to all four sites and 3PL partners

**Scope** Buffalo, Kenosha, Seattle and Portland manufacturing sites; 3PLs; supply chain and sourcing; customer service

**Position summary**

U-C Coatings manufactures specialty coatings, wood protection and repair products for industrial and consumer markets. The **Director of Operations** leads the people, processes and resources that turn customer demand into safe, reliable production and accurate, timely delivery.

Reporting to the President, this leader is accountable for operating performance across four sites and the supporting supply chain, sourcing, logistics and customer service functions. The role requires regular time on the production floor, strong financial judgment, and the ability to develop capable site and functional leaders in a lean organization.

**Manufacturing and site leadership**

* Lead site leaders in Buffalo, NY, Kenosha, WI, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR; establish clear responsibilities, operating standards and performance expectations across the network.
* Translate demand into production, staffing and capacity plans; improve batch scheduling, filling, packaging, labor productivity and equipment utilization.
* Improve yield, reduce scrap and rework, and address recurring downtime through preventive maintenance, root cause analysis and practical process improvements.
* Evaluate production allocation, interplant transfers, capital investments and facility changes to improve service, cost and available capacity.

**Supply chain and sourcing**

* Own procurement and supplier performance for raw materials, packaging, purchased products and operating supplies; negotiate pricing, terms and service commitments.
* Lead monthly demand and supply planning with Sales and Finance; align forecasts, purchasing and production with service goals and working capital requirements.
* Set replenishment and inventory policies by item and site; improve inventory accuracy, reduce excess and obsolete stock, and prevent material shortages.
* Develop qualified alternate sources and continuity plans for critical inputs; coordinate supplier and material changes with Technical and Quality before implementation.

**Logistics and third party warehousing**

* Manage 3PL contracts, service standards and performance reviews, including inventory reconciliation, order accuracy, shipping performance, claims and invoice audits.
* Control inbound, outbound, parcel, LTL and interplant freight costs; improve packaging, carrier selection and routing while meeting customer requirements.

**Customer Service**

* Lead Customer Service from order receipt through fulfillment; improve order entry accuracy, acknowledgments, delivery commitments and response times.
* Connect Customer Service, Sales, planning, plants and 3PLs so customers receive reliable commitments and proactive updates on shortages or delays.
* Resolve escalated service issues, returns and credits with Sales, Finance and Technical; use complaint and shipping error trends to eliminate repeat failures.

**Safety quality and compliance**

* Hold site leaders accountable for safe operations, training, inspections, incident reporting and timely corrective action; maintain clear escalation and stop-work authority.
* Partner with internal specialists and outside advisers to meet applicable workplace safety, environmental, storage, waste and shipping requirements at each site.
* Ensure operating teams follow approved formulations, batch records, quality checks, labeling and lot traceability; support product launches and process changes with Technical and Quality.

**Financial management and people leadership**

* Own operating budgets and explain labor, material, freight and overhead variances with Finance; deliver verified savings and capital projects with clear returns.
* Coach and evaluate site and functional leaders; build staffing, cross-training and succession plans, and address performance issues promptly with HR support.
* Run weekly site and consolidated scorecard reviews covering service, cost, quality, inventory and people; assign owners and deadlines and verify corrective actions.

**Qualifications**

* Ten or more years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including at least five years leading managers or major operating functions.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple manufacturing sites or a comparably complex manufacturing and distribution network; ability to lead dispersed teams.
* Practical experience with procurement, inventory planning, logistics, outsourced warehousing and customer fulfillment; strong cost and financial analysis skills.
* Experience with ERP and MRP systems, Excel, operating scorecards and continuous improvement; ability to turn data into decisions and sustained results.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, supply chain, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Coatings, chemicals, adhesives, sealants or other batch manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.

**Measures of success**

Accountable measures include safety controls; on-time, in-full delivery; labor efficiency; yield and cost of poor quality; inventory accuracy and turns; supplier and 3PL performance; freight costs; order accuracy; and leadership development. Agree on targets with the CEO after validating baselines.

**Initial priorities and working environment**

Within 90 days, assess the sites and key partners, validate scorecards, and agree on an improvement plan with owners, deadlines and financial impact. Work includes office, plant and warehouse activities, required PPE (company-provided), regular travel and occasional support outside business hours. Essential duties may be performed with reasonable accommodation.

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

U-C Coatings is a leading manufacturer and supplier of premium wood protection products. For more than 50 years, our products have been used in a variety of industries, including hardwood and softwood logging and lumber production, wood products, manufacturing, woodworking, and wood decking markets.

Our products are used worldwide to protect, conserve, and enhance forest resources. Our goal is to help our customers achieve more with less waste and provide the highest level of protection for their products.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

This role is an in-person role located within the company’s Kenosha, WI location. There is a moderate noise level within the work environment. Compliance with applicable Company policies including maintaining a drug-free workplace and adhering to all safety policies and procedures is required.

**DISCLAIMERS:**

UC Coatings, LLC reserves the right to revise, change or modify the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time to meet business needs. This job description may not list all duties for this position. This job description is not a contract of employment, and all UC Coatings, LLC employment unless otherwise disclosed is “at will” and either the incumbent or UC Coatings, LLC may terminate employment at any time for any reason.

UC Coatings, LLC is an Equal opportunity, inclusive employer and will consider all applicants for employment with the Company based on merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Operations management: 5 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Contract Manufacturing Director
new_roles.description:
**Lassonde Pappas & Co.** is a US Leader in beverage manufacturing dedicated to our team members, customers and consumers satisfaction. We remain committed to our small-town roots and rural values. **Hardworking** and **caring** are qualities that make our teams special. Since 1942, we’ve been producing delicious products for our customers across the country!

To provide the best for our customers, we focus on building the best team by creating and advancing an inclusive environment amongst our diverse workforces. If you’re passionate about customer satisfaction, reliable, and committed to being and doing better, join us!

**We value each of our employees’ total wellbeing. To support employees in all stages of their wellness journey, we have a robust benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage options, growth and development potential, along with 401-K, Life & Disability Insurance, PTO, Tuition Reimbursement, Health Fairs, Gym Membership Discounts, and so much more!**

*Pay Range for this position is: $165,000-$200,000 plus annual bonus, depending on experience and geographical location.*

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The **Director, Contract Manufacturing** reports to the Vice President, Integrated Planning, U.S. Beverage and is based in Cherry Hill, New Jersey.

The Director is responsible for defining the role of contract manufacturing within the Beverage Division’s broader supply network and translating business plans into clear external capacity, capability, geographic, and partnership requirements across the U.S. and Canada. This role leads the development and optimization of the contract manufacturing network to ensure the right capabilities, capacity, cost, quality, service, and resilience to support business growth.

The Director oversees relationships with contract manufacturing partners from initial capability assessment and commercial selection through operational integration, product launch, ongoing governance, and continuous performance improvement.

The Director aligns internal business and functional leaders around external manufacturing decisions and builds productive relationships with strategic partners. The role ensures that external manufacturing resources are positioned to support the division’s growth plans, innovation agenda, service expectations, cost objectives, and business continuity requirements.

**Up to 25% travel required**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**External Manufacturing Strategy & Network Optimization**

* Define and execute the contract manufacturing strategy for the Beverage Division across the U.S. and Canada, translating business requirements into external manufacturing capacity, capability, geographic, and partnership needs.
* Optimize the existing contract manufacturing network by assessing manufacturing capabilities, capacity, geographic footprint, technology, cost, service, quality, and supply risk.
* Partner with Integrated Planning, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and other key stakeholders on make-versus-buy decisions and long-term capacity strategies.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the external manufacturing landscape to identify new capabilities, technologies, potential partners, and opportunities to strengthen the overall supply network.

**Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Management**

* Translate business requirements into sourcing strategies for externally manufactured products, balancing economics, available capacity, technical capability, speed, flexibility, and supply risk.
* Lead competitive sourcing and partner-selection activities, including market assessment, RFIs/RFPs/RFQs, commercial evaluation, supplier selection, negotiation, contracting, and implementation.
* Structure and negotiate commercial agreements that clearly define pricing, capacity commitments, service expectations, quality requirements, flexibility provisions, liability, and business continuity obligations.
* Develop fact-based sourcing recommendations considering total cost of ownership, capacity, capability, risk, and overall strategic fit.
* Establish pricing mechanisms and commercial frameworks that promote transparency, competitiveness, and sustainable productivity.
* Provide financial stewardship of external manufacturing spend through disciplined budgeting, forecasting, cost analysis, variance management, and productivity delivery.

**Supplier Relationship & Performance Management**

* Establish and lead a structured Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) approach for strategic contract manufacturing partners.
* Establish and maintain a robust performance management framework and supplier scorecards for the contract manufacturing network.
* Establish a disciplined operating rhythm with strategic partners, supported by agreed performance measures, periodic operating and executive business reviews, documented recovery plans, and clear ownership of actions.
* Build strategic relationships with key external manufacturing partners to improve service, strengthen capacity and flexibility, accelerate innovation, and identify productivity opportunities.
* Lead supplier and network risk assessments and ensure appropriate business continuity, contingency, and risk mitigation plans are developed and maintained.

The Director owns the performance framework for the external manufacturing network, ensuring that targets reflect the division’s priorities for customer service, product quality, delivered cost, productivity, available capacity, launch execution, contractual compliance, and supply continuity. The role is responsible for converting performance information into timely decisions, recovery actions, and clear visibility of results and risks for business leadership.

**Commercialization & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Lead the external manufacturing workstream for new product commercialization, capacity expansions, product transfers, and new contract manufacturer onboarding.
* Partner with R&D, Marketing, Quality, Engineering, Operations, Integrated Planning, and other key functions to ensure new products and external manufacturing capabilities are launched on time, at target cost, and in accordance with quality and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure effective integration of contract manufacturers into the broader planning and supply network, including capacity planning, production planning, inventory management, service, and supply continuity.
* Coordinate resolution of operational and supply issues across internal functions and external manufacturing partners, ensuring clear ownership and escalating material business risks when required.

**Team Leadership & Governance**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Contract Manufacturing team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and individual development plans.
* Establish the governance, processes, tools, decision rights, and performance standards required to effectively manage the external manufacturing network.
* Ensure accurate and actionable contract manufacturing information is maintained, including supplier capabilities, capacity, pricing, commercial terms, products/SKUs, performance, and contractual commitments.
* Provide business leadership with regular visibility into external manufacturing cost, capacity, service, performance, supply risk, and opportunities, enabling timely and informed decision-making.
* Drive cross-functional alignment and accountability for initiatives and decisions affecting the external manufacturing network.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in contract manufacturing, external manufacturing, strategic sourcing, procurement, operations, or supply chain, preferably within the CPG, food, or beverage industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing third-party manufacturing relationships and complex commercial agreements.
* Strong experience in strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, contracting, and supplier relationship management.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Operations, Planning, Quality, R&D, Finance, Procurement, and Commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate cost, capacity, capability, service, quality, and supply risk and translate analysis into effective business recommendations.
* Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost modeling, and productivity initiatives.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and external business partners within a complex matrix organization.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and change-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the food, beverage, or broader CPG industry.
* Experience managing a multi-site or North American external manufacturing network.
* Experience with new product commercialization, manufacturing transfers, and external partner onboarding.
* APICS/ASCM certification, CPSM, or comparable supply chain/procurement certification.
* MBA or advanced degree.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Directly manages three employees, providing coaching, development, performance management, and clear accountability for results.
* Establishes team priorities, objectives, and performance expectations aligned with the contract manufacturing strategy and broader business goals.
* Builds team capability and expertise while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and results.
* Provides leadership across a broader cross-functional network, influencing internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners to achieve service, quality, cost, capacity, innovation, and supply continuity objectives.
* Leads through influence across a matrix organization, driving alignment and accountability among internal functions and strategic external partners.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS**

This position requires sufficient physical ability to work in a typical office setting; driving a motor vehicle, taking the plane, doing north American travel and occasionally working in the field.

**FREQUENT:** sitting, upward and downward flexion of neck; fine finger dexterity and light to moderate finger pressure to include extended periods of keyboard and mouse use, side-to-side turning of neck, walking, standing, bending and stooping, pushing/pulling, twisting at waist, moderate wrist torque to twist equipment knobs and dials.

**OCCASIONAL:** squatting, kneeling, reach above and at shoulder height, moderate grasp to manipulate reference books and manuals; lifting objects weighing 20 – 35 lbs. from below waist to above shoulders and transporting distances up to 50 feet.

**VISION:** Ability to see in the normal visual range with or without correction.

**HEARING:** Ability to hear in the normal audio range with or without correction.

**This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of the responsibilities that are required to successfully perform in this position. Other duties as assigned are part of every job description. The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform essential job functions.**

**Lassonde Pappas & Co., Inc provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.**

**This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.**

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority | Lakeville, New York**

**Salary:$110,000-$130,000 | First Review: December 4, 2026**

**Lead Essential Operations. Develop the Workforce. Prepare for Growth.**

The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority (LCWSA) is seeking an experienced water and wastewater operations professional to help guide its operations through a period of significant growth and expansion.

Over the past five years, the Authority has expanded its water system by 20% while assuming responsibility for additional treatment facilities. With further growth anticipated, LCWSA is investing in its infrastructure, operations, and workforce to meet increasing demands.

The Director of Operations oversees the Authority's water distribution and sewer collection systems, including maintenance activities, field resources, staff development, regulatory compliance, and a $3.5 million operating budget.

**The Opportunity**

The next Director of Operations will help prepare LCWSA for continued expansion while strengthening daily operations and developing its workforce. Priorities include preventive maintenance, infrastructure planning, effective use of operational resources, and training and mentoring employees as experienced team members approach retirement.

LCWSA seeks a collaborative, hands-on leader who combines practical field experience and technical expertise with sound judgment, organizational skills, and a commitment to staff development. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with employees, Authority leadership, municipal partners, contractors, and regulatory agencies while ensuring safe, reliable service to the communities LCWSA serves.

**Qualifications**

Candidates must meet **one** of the following education and experience requirements:

● A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction, or environmental science, plus four years of qualifying experience; or

● An associate's degree in water/wastewater technology or a related field, plus six years of qualifying experience; or

● A high school diploma or equivalent, plus eight years of qualifying experience.

Qualifying experience must be in water treatment, water distribution, sewer collection or treatment, or construction of water and sewer facilities.

All candidates must have at least three years of cumulative supervisory or leadership experience, which may include employee supervision, project management, operational oversight, or coordination of work activities. A valid driver's license and safe driving record are required.

An engineering background may be beneficial but is not required.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The salary range is **$110,000-$130,000**. Benefits include fully paid health insurance, employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA), participation in the New York State Retirement System, and paid time off.

This is an on-site position based in Lakeville, New York. Livingston County residency is preferred but not required. Relocation assistance may be negotiated.

**Ready to Explore the Opportunity?**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. A first review of candidates will be 12/4/26.

To apply, submit a resume and cover letter through the Pracademic Partners Recruitment Portal:

https://www.pracademicpartners.com/current-recruitments

**Questions or confidential inquiries:**

Dr. Ian M. Coyle, ICMA-CM 
President & Founder, Pracademic Partners 
ian@pracademicpartners.com | 585.943.0589

*The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply.*

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $110,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Geneseo, NY 14454 (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Director, Co-Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director, Co-Manufacturing is responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing Mama's Creations' external manufacturing network to support the company's growth strategy, customer commitments, and operational objectives. This position serves as the enterprise leader for all co-manufacturing relationships, ensuring external partners consistently deliver exceptional service, Grandma Quality, food safety compliance, cost performance, and capacity support.

The Director will build strategic partnerships with contract manufacturers, lead commercialization and capacity expansion initiatives, and ensure co-manufacturing operations align with Mama's values of Commit to Craftsmanship, Nurture Relationships, Honor Heritage, and deliver Grandma Quality.

This role requires a highly collaborative leader who can influence cross-functional partners across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, FSQA, R&D, Finance, Sales, and Customer Service while holding external manufacturing partners accountable for operational excellence and business results.

Position can be based in East Rutherford, NJ or Farmingdale, NY

**Co-Manufacturer Strategy & Relationship Management**

* Develop and execute the company's co-manufacturing strategy to support growth, innovation, customer requirements, and capacity needs.
* Identify, evaluate, qualify, negotiate, and onboard new co-manufacturing partners.
* Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with co-manufacturer leadership teams.
* Lead business reviews with co-manufacturing partners, focusing on performance, service, quality, cost, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure clear accountability, governance, and communication structures exist across all manufacturing partners.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for critical business, operational, quality, and supply issues.
* Relationship management and development of multi-site 3PL solution network.

**Operational Performance**

* Own service, inventory, capacity, quality, and cost performance across the co-manufacturing network.
* Establish performance metrics and scorecards to monitor supplier execution and compliance.
* Drive improvements in on-time delivery, schedule adherence, yield, waste reduction, and production efficiency.
* Partner with Supply Planning and Operations teams to align manufacturing capacity with demand forecasts and growth plans.
* Ensure co-manufacturers maintain appropriate labor, equipment, and material resources to support business requirements.

**Commercialization & Product Launches**

* Lead co-manufacturer activities associated with new product commercialization and customer-specific initiatives.
* Partner with Culinary Innovation, R&D, Operations, and FSQA teams to ensure successful product transfers and launches.
* Coordinate production trials, scale-up activities, process validations, and first-production runs.
* Ensure accurate production documentation, specifications, and operational readiness prior to launch.

**Quality, Food Safety & Compliance**

* Partner closely with FSQA to ensure all co-manufacturers consistently meet Mama's food safety, quality, regulatory, and customer requirements.
* Support supplier qualification, audit programs, CAPA activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP, SQF, BRC, and customer-specific standards.
* Lead cross-functional response efforts related to quality events, recalls, customer complaints, or regulatory concerns.

**Financial Management**

* Own co-manufacturing budgets and financial performance.
* Collaborate with Procurement and Finance to negotiate manufacturing agreements and cost structures.
* Identify and execute productivity initiatives that improve margins while maintaining product quality and customer service.
* Evaluate capital and investment opportunities within the co-manufacturing network to support long-term growth.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and implement operational excellence initiatives across manufacturing partners.
* Leverage KPIs, root-cause analysis, and performance reviews to drive sustainable improvement.
* Promote Lean Manufacturing, waste reduction, and process optimization opportunities throughout the network.
* Share best practices among co-manufacturing partners to elevate overall network performance.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, trust, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships that support enterprise business objectives.
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to Operations leadership regarding network optimization and growth strategies

**Success Metrics**

* The Director, Co-Manufacturing will be measured on:
* Customer service levels
* OTIF (On-Time In-Full) performance
* Product quality performance
* Food safety compliance
* Network capacity utilization
* Manufacturing cost improvement
* Productivity savings
* Commercialization success rate
* Supplier scorecard performance
* Inventory performance
* Customer complaint trends
* EBITDA contribution from network optimization initiatives

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing, supply chain, operations, or co-manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years managing contract manufacturers or external manufacturing networks.
* Experience within food manufacturing, refrigerated foods, CPG, or consumer packaged goods.

* Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Compensation Range:**

$122,800 - $204,600

**Plant Manager**

Department: Operations / Manufacturing

Reports To: Director of Operations

Direct Reports: Production Managers, Facilities Manager, and other assigned manufacturing leadership

Scope: Three manufacturing buildings / multi-product HVAC manufacturing operation

**Position**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day-to-day execution of manufacturing operations across three buildings within a large HVAC manufacturing facility. This position provides hands-on leadership to ensure the plant safely produces high-quality products on schedule, at the required volume and cost, while developing a strong culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

The Plant Manager is responsible for coordinating production activities across multiple manufacturing processes and buildings, including assembly, sheet metal fabrication, welding, piping/refrigeration, testing, material flow, and final product completion.

The successful candidate will establish clear operating standards, drive cross-functional accountability, develop manufacturing leadership, remove operational constraints, and ensure the plant has the people, processes, equipment, and infrastructure required to support current production and future growth.

This position is expected to be highly visible on the manufacturing floor and serves as the primary operational leader responsible for translating business objectives into daily execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Plant Leadership & Operational Execution**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for manufacturing operations across all three buildings.
* Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operating priorities aligned with business requirements.
* Ensure production plans are executed safely, efficiently, and according to customer commitments.
* Maintain strong communication and coordination between buildings and manufacturing departments.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for production performance.
* Lead daily plant operating reviews and ensure corrective actions are completed.
* Identify and remove constraints affecting throughput, capacity, quality, or delivery.
* Maintain appropriate production capacity, staffing, equipment, and infrastructure to support business growth.
* Ensure standardized processes are consistently followed across all buildings.
* Maintain a strong management presence on the manufacturing floor.

**2. Production Management**

* Lead Production Managers and ensure effective management of production personnel.
* Establish production priorities based on customer demand, capacity, material availability, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure production schedules are achieved while balancing labor, equipment, materials, and testing capacity.
* Monitor production flow from fabrication through final assembly and testing.
* Develop and maintain effective production metrics and visual management systems.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Ensure appropriate escalation processes are in place when production performance is at risk.
* Coordinate production activities between the three buildings to maximize overall plant capacity.

**3. Safety, Environmental & Compliance**

* Establish safety as the facility’s highest operational priority.
* Partner with EHS leadership to maintain a strong safety culture across all three buildings.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, company requirements, and applicable industry standards.
* Drive accountability for safe work practices at all levels of the organization.
* Ensure timely investigation and corrective action following incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Support programs designed to reduce injuries, ergonomic risks, environmental impacts, and workplace hazards.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate safety training and understand their responsibilities.

**4. Quality**

* Partner with Quality leadership to ensure products meet customer, engineering, and company requirements.
* Establish accountability for first-time quality and defect prevention.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, warranty issues, and production defects.
* Ensure quality issues are rapidly escalated and contained.
* Support root-cause analysis and corrective-action processes.
* Promote quality at the source rather than relying on downstream inspection.
* Maintain compliance with the plant's quality management system and ISO requirements.

**5. Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainability of Lean Manufacturing Principles throughout all three buildings.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.
* Drive 5S, visual management, standardized work, problem solving, waste elimination, and flow improvements.
* Support Value Stream Mapping and improvement of end-to-end product flow.
* Establish measurable improvement targets for productivity, quality, delivery, inventory, and cost.
* Partner with Lean/Manufacturing Engineering leadership to prioritize improvement projects based on business impact.
* Ensure Lean improvements are sustained through management systems and standard work.
* Develop frontline leaders capable of independently identifying and solving operational problems.

**6. People Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Develop a high-performing manufacturing leadership team.
* Establish clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Coach and develop Production Managers, Supervisors, and other manufacturing leaders.
* Identify organizational capability gaps and work with Human Resources to develop staffing and development plans.
* Support workforce planning and hiring activities necessary to meet production requirements.
* Establish effective onboarding and training processes for new employees.
* Develop succession plans for key manufacturing positions.
* Promote employee engagement, teamwork, ownership, and accountability.
* Address performance issues promptly and consistently.

**7. Capacity & Business Growth**

* Develop manufacturing capacity plans to support current and future customer demand.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Finance, Materials, and other functions to identify capacity requirements.
* Evaluate labor, equipment, floor space, testing, utilities, and infrastructure requirements.
* Support capital planning and justification for new equipment and facility improvements.
* Ensure new production areas and buildings are effectively integrated into the overall manufacturing system.
* Develop ramp-up plans for new products, programs, and production transfers.
* Ensure the plant can scale production without compromising safety, quality, or delivery performance.

**8. Cross-Functional Leadership**

Work closely with:

* Director of Operations
* Production
* Materials
* Production Planning
* Logistics
* Quality
* EHS
* Lean / Manufacturing Engineering
* Facilities
* Maintenance
* Engineering
* Finance
* Human Resources
* Supply Chain
* Sales / Customer teams

Ensure cross-functional issues are identified early, assigned to the appropriate owner, and driven to resolution.

**9. Facilities, Equipment & Infrastructure**

* Partner with Facilities and Maintenance leadership to ensure buildings, utilities, production equipment, cranes, test infrastructure, and other critical assets support production requirements.
* Establish preventive and predictive maintenance expectations.
* Ensure critical production equipment has appropriate contingency plans.
* Support capital equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and production launch.
* Ensure facility expansion projects are integrated into manufacturing operations with minimal disruption to production.

**10. Performance Management & Accountability**

Establish and maintain a plant operating system based on measurable performance.

Key performance indicators should include:

Safety

* Recordable incident rate
* Lost-time incidents
* Near misses
* Safety observations
* Corrective-action closure

Quality

* First-pass yield
* Scrap
* Rework
* Customer defects
* Warranty / quality escapes

Delivery

* On-time delivery
* Schedule attainment
* Production attainment
* Manufacturing lead time
* Test-bay utilization / throughput

Productivity

* Labor productivity
* Units per labor hour
* OEE where applicable
* Direct labor efficiency
* Throughput

Cost

* Manufacturing cost
* Labor variance
* Scrap cost
* Overtime
* Cost of poor quality

Lean

* 5S performance
* Kaizen completion
* Standard work compliance
* Improvement savings
* Value-stream performance

The Plant Manager will ensure performance is reviewed routinely and that corrective actions have clearly identified owners and due dates.

**Leadership Expectations**

The Plant Manager is expected to:

* Lead from the floor rather than from the office.
* Establish a culture of accountability without creating a culture of blame.
* Make decisions based on facts and data.
* Escalate issues early rather than allowing problems to become emergencies.
* Develop leaders instead of personally solving every problem.
* Maintain a strong focus on safety and quality while driving production.
* Create alignment between the three buildings rather than allowing them to operate as independent plants.
* Establish consistent standards and expectations across the operation.
* Communicate clearly with employees, leadership, and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrate urgency while maintaining disciplined problem solving.
* Build an organization capable of supporting significant business growth.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 3+ years of plant or multi-department manufacturing management experience.
* Experience managing large manufacturing organizations, multiple production areas, and facilities.
* Experience in HVAC, refrigeration, industrial equipment, sheet metal, welding, assembly, or related manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant production growth or plant expansion.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience managing safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.
* Strong financial and business acumen.
* Experience developing and leading supervisors and managers.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environment.

new_roles.description:
Company Statement: Graham Packaging is a people, planet and values-based company and a leader in sustainable packaging manufacturing. From the kitchen to the laundry room, Graham Packaging is part of your everyday life. For employees at Graham, our Blue Culture is part of their everyday lives, too. In other words, Blue is how we do things here. At Graham, we are united by a clear vision. We know our part and help those around us know theirs, encouraging one another to continuously improve. We create a safe, challenging environment to innovate by supporting creative ideas and new ways of thinking. We take the initiative to cultivate our individual growth and help others do the same, while keeping ourselves and one another accountable. And we actively promote cooperation, collaboration, integrity and respect across regions and teams to foster an engaged, diverse and connected workforce. We value our employees, and a Blue Culture allows for the most rewarding employee experience as part of the Graham family. Blue is how we feel about what we do—together—to create a better tomorrow. Working at Graham means you lead constructively with clear goals, use diverse thinking to drive excellence, accountability, innovation, as well as demonstrating collaboration, embracing learning, and taking action for continuous improvement and growth. Overview:

Plant Managers are responsible for overall effectiveness of day-to-day manufacturing operations through direction of personnel in the management of safety, quality, customer service, efficient utilization of resources, equipment, materials and manpower procedures and programs. The primary duties of a Plant Manager include:

* Understands, follows and enforces all established safety, health, quality GMP and Company policies, procedures and recognized practices.
* Understands, follows and enforces all established policies, procedures and recognized practices.
* Leads the plant safety initiatives through the participation and development of safety training programs, plant safety meetings, safety audits and by encouraging employee involvement through safety suggestion and recognition programs.
* Leads the plant quality initiatives through the implementation of corrective actions from customer or internal complaints, coordinating new product qualifications, and participating in internal and external quality system audits and developing and implementing corrective action plans.
* Responsible for the selection, training, growth and development of shift and staff personnel to attain organizational goals
* Reviews operating statements for all departments and directs manufacturing operations so that all plant costs are within budgetary standards.
* Develops and maintains sound relations with customers and works with them to identify systems improvements and possible supply chain cost reductions.
* Ensures continuous improvement plans are developed and implemented to ensure short and long range goals are in process.
* Oversees the production planning process to ensure customer requirements are satisfied.
* Maintains contact with sales department and customer service to effectively meet and maximize utilization of plant facilities.
* Act as the Plant’s Project Manager on new initiatives involving equipment and molds.
* Participates in monthly, quarterly and year-end physical inventories in accordance with corporate guidelines.
* Oversee the creation and implementation of plants strategic and tactical plans that provided the needed focus and drive to achieve the plant and overall company objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement plans using Operation Excellence tools across cross functional departments.
* Promote an open door and team building environment policy.
* May be responsible for special projects related to other functional areas

Qualifications:

A Bachelor’s Degree and/or related plant management experience; or equivalent combination of education and related plant management experience is required. A minimum of five years’ experience in an operations supervisory or management role in a manufacturing environment with demonstrated leadership skills strongly preferred. Six Sigma, Lean, and/or Kaizen experience preferred.

Plant Managers are required to interact with other managers, employees, vendors, and customers. Therefore, the following skills and proficiencies are also essential requirements of the position:

* Ability to maintain regular, predictable, and punctual attendance.
* Computer usage and typing skills are essential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers.
* Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service.
* Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
* Communicates effectively: conveys facts and information clearly both verbally and orally.
* Collaborates well with others: proactively contributes to group objectives; volunteers to help others.

Compensation Statement: The expected salary range for the position described in this posting is made in accordance with the legal mandates of certain jurisdictions within the United States. The final agreed-upon compensation is based on individual qualifications and experience. Benefits Statement: Benefits include medical, dental, vision and basic life insurance. Employees are able to enroll in the company’s 401K Employee Saving Plan and may participate in its Employee Wellness Program. Employees will also receive paid time off in accordance with company policy and state law requirements. EEO Disclaimer: Graham Packaging is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, religion, creed, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:** 
Responsible for the management of all aspects of a sand mining and production facility. This position will utilize budgets, production goals, and effective communication. Safety must be a top priority. 
 
**Job Requirements:** 
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
 
Direct the following department personnel to ensure safety and productivity is achieved. 
1. Mine Team 
2. Wash Operators 
3. Dry Plant Operators 
4. Quality/Lab 
5. Maintenance

* Efficiently schedule and supervise hourly personnel for weekly operations, monitor timecards, vacations, and control overtime.
* Work with corporate HR department on staffing needs and employee issues.
* Handle discipline and grievances, as required, while maintaining acceptable labor and employee relations.
* Accurately collect, review, and forward operating data, such as mine, wash, and dry plant production reports.
* Assist HSE Coordinator in collecting the necessary data for MSHA and DNR reports.
* Communicate effectively and timely with owners, corporate directors, and/or other management of problems or potential problems that affect the proper operation of the plant. Problems may include personnel, equipment, transportation, quality, or raw materials.
* Direct activities safely to achieve optimum rates of productivity consistent with long/short range goals
* Direct and coordinate plant/mine related projects with Director of Mining
* Assisting in the preparation of capital projects and plan, and their completion • Direct and oversee activities performed by subcontractors.
* Monitor the mine operation to ensure compliance with all regulations concerning air emissions, water discharge, erosion and sedimentation control.
* Assist, implement, and comply with ISO 9001 quality program.
* Review quality reports daily and ensure quality standards are being followed.
* Evaluate with the EHS Coordinator the company’s training program and conditions in the plant, creating a culture of safety that exceeds MSHA guidelines and regulations.
* Ensure safety and good housekeeping by being active in all programs.
* Recommend and/or purchase materials and supplies as necessary, utilizing corporate purchasing department. Recommend equipment and process modifications to improve efficiencies.
* Ensure work standards, policies, plans, and procedures are enforced. Support management’s policies and programs.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS**

* Team-oriented, an effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and have the ability and willingness to build rapport with department team members and external departments.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Understanding our company functions as a cohesive operation, and often employees serve in many roles and various functions or capacities.
* Develop working relationships with other corporate personnel and plants.
* Maintain open communications with subordinates, peers, and superiors.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree, in Business Management or related field
* 3 to 5 years of related experience in a position of leadership, Surface Mining Experience preferred
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Advanced experience working with MSHA Safety and Environmental competency
* Supervisory skills
* Budgetary skills - Capital planning and projects
* Short and long-term planning and scheduling
* Leadership Skills

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Pass toxicity test.
* Medical clearance to wear respiratory protection.
* Team?oriented, effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and
* have the ability and willingness to build rapport with team members and external agencies.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Willingness to further training or education, if requested.

new_roles.description:
Are you interested in working for a company that fosters growth opportunities, community involvement and a team-oriented atmosphere? ClarkDietrich fosters a work-life balance and offers competitive compensation and benefits. Join a team that is STRONGER THAN STEEL℠, by applying to become a Plant Manager at our **Riverside** location.

**SUMMARY**

The **Plant Manager** is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the entire manufacturing facility to include safety, quality, efficiencies, and meeting customer expectations. This includes driving strategic plans that ensure that production goals are met in the safest and most cost-effective manner, while delivering expected financial results.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Direct and manage plant operations for production, maintenance, quality, and shipping and receiving.
* Coordinate plant activities through planning with departmental supervisors/managers to ensure that all manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a timely and cost-effective manner.
* Oversee all aspects of the day-to-day plant operations, including production, maintenance, and logistics.
* Develop, monitor and control plant budget, through active planning and understanding of P&L to ensure financial targets are met.
* Implements cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries.
* Leads the effort and drives Lean Manufacturing tools and techniques fostering continuous improvement within the facility. Acts in a proactive fashion regarding problem resolution.
* Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or adjust plant facilities and equipment when necessary. Investigate and recommend new equipment or process improvements.
* Actively participated with Regional Sales Management to develop and manage the Regional Operating Unit into a team-oriented environment.
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Controls and minimizes labor overtime, premium freight, and repair expenses.
* Provides leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Incorporates shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Schedules and conducts plant communication which focus on key operative measurements, safety topics and .
* Onsite contact for government agencies, landlords and various other vendors

**SAFETY**

* Strives to improve the plant's safety accident record year after year in creating a positive safety culture for all employees. Conducts safety walks of the facility on a weekly basis.

* Monitors the activities of all employees and provides feedback and discipline to promote a safe workplace.
* Oversee the development and organization of all safety related documentation.
* Ensures and develops all required safety related training and promotes programs to lead safe behaviors.
* Audits equipment and the shop floor for safety related improvements.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Supervise plant staff and ensure employee safety.
* Mentor staff to create a productive and positive work environment.
* Accountable to Establish strong relationships that foster engaging collaborative influence.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Mechanically Inclined.
* Problem Solver.
* Team Oriented.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in related field or five years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment, strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Basic computer experience with Microsoft Word and Excel
* The military equivalent will be recognized in lieu of education and/or experience.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

* Basic mathematical skills, addition, subtraction, multiplication and converting fractions into decimals.
* Ability to read a tape measure, micrometer, and caliper accurately.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Manufacturing facility exposed to heat and cold.
* Personal Protective Equipment is always required.
* Controlled Noise exposure
* Activity level is high-continuous movement.

**CLARKDIETRICH BENEFITS INCLUDE**

* Full benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts and Life Insurance)
* 401(k) with company match
* Annual Incentive Program
* Paid Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Community Service Day

Pay Transparency ClarkDietrich’s compensation program supports the company’s Vision and Values. We offer a competitive compensation, opportunities for advancement and a work-life balance.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

Sirtex Medical is a global leader in healthcare, with offices in the U.S., Australia, Germany, and Singapore, dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

Our mission is to be at the forefront of minimally invasive cancer and embolization therapies. By partnering with physicians, we aim to provide innovative products that enhance patient outcomes and simplify treatments. Achieving this ambitious goal requires passionate and talented individuals who are committed to making a difference. Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted radiation therapy for liver cancer. To date, we have delivered over >150K doses across 50+ countries, significantly impacting patients' lives worldwide. Our success is fueled by our dedication to serving the medical community, maintaining professionalism, fostering a collaborative work culture, nurturing an entrepreneurial spirit, and continuously pursuing innovation and improvement.

At Sirtex, we are committed to creating a great workplace. We offer a range of benefits, programs, and services to support our employees, ensuring they have opportunities to contribute to our success and advance their careers. Join our inclusive community, where you can collaborate with talented colleagues, bring your ideas to life, and advance your career, all while delivering innovative healthcare solutions to patients.

 **Job Description**

**SCOPE:**

The Wilmington plant is the largest of 3 global Sirtex manufacturing site and serves as the principal production site of both SIR-Spheres microspheres and Lava product lines. The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the sites manufacturing operations, engineering, warehouse and product distribution.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

* Develop and lead execution of the site manufacturing strategy for both the SIR-Spheres and Lava value streams. Align site goals with Senior Leadership and Corporate objectives.
* Team Performance Management: lead, develop and mentor manufacturing team members.
* Manage production schedules, ensuring resource availability and capacity to meet demand, working closely with the Supply Chain team, using optimal schedules to minimize overall costs.
* Lead Continuous Improvement efforts, identifying process, equipment, product, and other opportunities, that reduce cost, improve quality and safety at the site.
* Full responsibility for developing and managing to site budget.
* Ensure resource and equipment capacity to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing.
* Set site target KPI’s managing OEE, Labor Efficiency, Scrap, Equipment Utilization, etc.
* Ensure product is built to specification and in compliance with all Quality System requirements.
* Manage the site engineering team to ensure equipment and processes are robust and meet all manufacturing requirements. Manage PM strategy and ensure that execution is completed on time.
* Support the Quality Department, working with on site Quality team members to ensure that compliance with all areas of the Sirtex QMS are being followed. Identify opportunities for improvement and work to implement them directly in the QMS.
* Work in conjunction with HSE/Facilities Department to ensure a safe working environment for all employees and that the facilities is maintained, and compliant with regulatory requirements for both the handling of radioactive materials and medical device manufacturing.
* Manage all shipping, receiving and warehousing activities. Ensure timely material receipt, inventory accuracy is maintained, and products are shipped on time.

 
**Qualifications**

**EDUCATIONAL PREREQUISITES AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline such as Chemistry or Biomedical field
* 5+ Years experience working in medical device or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Prior experience working with radioisotopes preferred.
* 3+ years of site management experience, with 10+ years of leadership experience.
* 6 Sigma Green belt preferred. Experience using 5S and Lean principles is preferred.

The anticipated annual base salary range and target bonus opportunity is $136,000 to $171,000 annually, plus a 15% target annual bonus.

The final position level and compensation will be determined based on non-discriminatory, job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, experience, education, and alignment with the position requirements. In addition to base salary and bonus eligibility, Sirtex offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid sick and vacation time, medical, dental, vision and life insurance, and a generous 401(k) matching program and other benefits, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines

Do you want to be part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the globe making a real difference to the quality of people’s lives. Sirtex recognizes that well-being, financial health, and work-life balance are crucial for our employees to achieve personal success.

Sirtex offers qualified candidates:

* Diverse and flexible work arrangements to achieve the optimum balance between work and personal responsibilities.
* A culture of respect, diversity, collaboration, and innovation fostering inclusiveness and superior performance.
* Attractive compensation and benefit packages which are practical, robust and equitable.
* A commitment to support ongoing professional growth through career development, on the job experiences and training opportunities.
* Challenging work which supports the development of new and better ways to improve clinical outcomes for oncology treatment around the world.
* An unwavering commitment to company values, employee safety and excellence in everything we do.

Diversity drives innovation; inclusion fosters belonging, growth and success. Sirtex believes that it takes multiple perspectives and voices to create a culture and workplace which fosters engagement, teamwork, and employee satisfaction to perform our best and deliver on commitments. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, included, and can share their ideas so that we can exceed even our own expectations.

Sirtex is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Sirtex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.
