new_roles.title: Plant Manager - Little Chute
new_roles.description:
Description:

**POSITION SUMMARY & KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all operational and financial activities and directly interacting and collaborating with all internal/external stakeholders and support departments. The Plant Manager will develop and execute long and short-term initiatives aligned to our broader business goals as an innovative label solutions partner.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure compliance and engagement with all Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) policies and procedures.
* Drive site performance by monitoring and managing key business metrics, including Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, Cost, Inventory, and Employee Engagement.
* Actively lead in EHS, training, safety observations, hazard identification, and safety committees
* Foster, develop, and implement Continuous Improvement (CI) activities through all facets of the business
* Full Profit & Loss (P&L) statement responsibility
* Strategic planning including capital investments, budgets, staffing, and capacity. Additional support to Sales, Estimating, and R&D on strategic planning
* Lead daily production activities by monitoring performance against targets and provide support in attaining levels of expected performance
* Lead and develop leaders to achieve established goals of safety, quality, service, production, and cost
* Ensure the plant has the necessary tools and training to successfully and efficiently meet their goals
* Provide direction and guidance to the team through coaching and counseling; motivate, empower, develop and recognize individual and team achievements
* Develop & implement best in class training programs
* Support development and roll out of Standard Work including Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Work Instructions (WI), One Point Lessons, (OPL) and Training Documentation
* Works closely with Planning, Quality, HR, Logistics, Engineering, Maintenance, and EHS to ensure proper production planning and utilization of resources on the right priorities to meet customer requirements
* Reviews daily production schedule to plan work and coworker’s assignments. Rebalance based on utilization of assets and resources.
* Provides proactive leadership, actions, and results on safety, quality, and CI topics
* Develop and implement workflow practices & policies that enhance speed and efficiency without compromising safety or product quality
* Lead the CI process utilizing operational tool sets (i.e Lean, Six Sigma, 6S, TPS, TPM.) to provide high levels of performance
* Lead coworkers in performing operations according to sound operating principles and company policies and procedures
* Provides support regarding the manufacturing process and makes recommendations regarding safety, quality, tools, equipment, costs/expenses
* Analyzes, supports, and presents results on operational and financial business goals and outcomes
* Recruit, hire, train, motivate, and develop coworkers in line with our core values and company policies and practices.
* Support our commercial teams on customer related matters
* Maintains a high standard of professional knowledge, ethics, and practices when dealing with customers, suppliers, peers, coworkers, and leadership
* Other duties as requested

Requirements:

**REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:**

* Familiar with CI, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and other current manufacturing concepts, practices, and procedures
* Effective verbal and written communication skills including ability to effectively train and develop others
* Ability to coordinate plant activities and create material, manufacturing and communication flow throughout the facility
* Must demonstrate excellent leadership, communication, and team building skills across direct reports as well as support departments
* Strong business acumen (leadership principles, strategic planning, critical thinking, budgeting, resource allocation, human resources, etc.)
* Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Experience with ERP systems

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Operations or relevant experience
* 7-15 years manufacturing experience with at least 5 years of relevant experience

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift products up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to work in a standing position for long periods of time
* Other physical demands may include climbing, crouching, bending, reaching, stooping, etc.

**Reasonable Accommodations Statement**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Heartland Label Printers is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

**We participate in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the work eligibility of all new hires following an accepted job offer.**

new_roles.description:
Plant Manager

**Piedmont, South Carolina | Industrial Adhesives**

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Plant Manager** to lead our manufacturing operation in **Piedmont, South Carolina**. This is a highly visible leadership role for a proven manufacturing leader who can **drive change, develop high-performing teams, strengthen accountability, and deliver operational excellence**.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, people-focused leader who can set a clear vision, engage employees at all levels, challenge the status quo, and build a culture centered on **safety, quality, continuous improvement, collaboration, and results**.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations, including **Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Continuous Improvement**.
* Lead **organizational and cultural change**, building employee engagement, accountability, and ownership.
* Develop, coach, and strengthen the plant leadership team while building the organization's future talent pipeline.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with EHS requirements.
* Drive operational excellence using **Lean Six Sigma, OEE, VSM, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement tools**.
* Deliver plant financial, productivity, quality, customer service, and inventory objectives.
* Partner across Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Sales, and other business functions to achieve business goals.
* Identify and eliminate barriers, improve processes, and create sustainable improvements in plant performance.
* Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor and actively engage with supervisors and employees.
* Lead and support capital investments and improvement initiatives aligned with business strategy.

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing, engineering, or operations experience.
* Proven manufacturing leadership experience with a strong record of **leading change and improving performance**.
* Demonstrated ability to **build, coach, and lead high-performing teams**.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to drive accountability and results.
* Experience with Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Chemical, specialty chemical, adhesives, batch/process manufacturing, or similar experience preferred.

The Leader We're Looking For

You are a **visible, decisive, and engaging leader** who knows how to bring people along through change. You set clear expectations, hold yourself and others accountable, develop talent, and create an environment where employees are empowered to solve problems and improve the business.

Most importantly, you can **deliver today's results while transforming the organization for tomorrow**.

new_roles.description:
Contech Engineered Solutions LLC provides site solutions for engineers, contractors, architects, and owners. The Contech portfolio includes bridges, drainage, erosion control, retaining wall, sanitary sewer, and stormwater management products. Through cost-effective engineered solutions, we help build, support, and sustain land development projects while protecting the environment.

**Why Join Our Team?**

At Contech Engineered Solutions, we foster a positive and collaborative work environment where teamwork and cooperation are at the forefront. As a Plant Manager, you will be the driving force behind directing and supervising manufacturing operations at our plant, ensuring the highest level of product quality while optimizing production efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

**What We Offer:**

* **Work-Life Balance:** We understand the importance of achieving your professional goals without compromising your personal life.
* **Career Growth:** Join an industry leader renowned for world-class design, manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution. This is an opportunity to propel your career forward.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We provide a comprehensive benefits package with customizable options that meet your needs and those of your family.

**About the Role:**

As a Plant Manager, you will be responsible for:

* **Leadership:** Provide leadership and direction to a team of 15-20 employees. This includes selection, development, and evaluation of personnel to ensure a technically competent and highly motivated workforce.
* **Operations Management:** Oversee the entire manufacturing process, from receipt of materials to shipping. You will utilize our facilities, equipment, and personnel to achieve the highest level of product production while ensuring safety and quality standards are met at the lowest possible cost.
* **Safety:** Develop and maintain high plant standards of safety and work conditions, administer safety programs, and ensure compliance with all safety regulations, including stormwater tests and Pollution Protection Plans.
* **Communication:** Effectively communicate organizational policies and procedures and provide daily direction to various staff functions, including production scheduling, administration, inventory management, order process, and transportation.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Possess a deep understanding of all manufacturing processes and production equipment.
* **Performance Analysis:** Analyze monthly metrics related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and inventory.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Stay current with Interstate Commerce Commission and Department of Transportation regulations, as well as customer and government agency specifications.
* **Customer Engagement:** Coordinate directly with internal and external customers on orders, routes, specifications, pricing, and shipping to ensure the production of high-quality products in line with profit goals and strategies.
* **Quality Assurance:** Ensure all quality procedures are adhered to and documented in compliance with company policies.
* **Inventory Management:** Maintain proper inventory levels to support the local market and make necessary adjustments as required.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5 years of supervisory or leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP Operating Systems.
* Broad knowledge of business functions, including safety, quality, production operations, accounting, inventory management, cost control/profit and loss management, and shipping.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset.
* Broad technical knowledge of product and production methods.

If you are a seasoned leader with a track record of success in manufacturing operations, possess a deep understanding of safety and quality standards, and are looking for a new challenge, we encourage you to apply for the Plant Manager position. Your expertise will be instrumental in maintaining and improving our production processes.

**Ready to Apply?**

* The process is simple. Click on the “apply” button to get started. Good luck!

Contech is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identification, transgender status, national origin, protected veteran status, or status as an individual with a disability. Click here to view information regarding your Equal Employment Opportunity rights and protections: Know Your Rights & EEO is the Law Supplement. Contech is a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact the Contech Recruiting team at (513) 645-7000.

new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a team-oriented, hands-on Plant Manager with a robust background in maintenance leadership. This role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, with a particular emphasis on developing and executing a world-class maintenance program at our mill in St. Maries, Idaho. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement, ensuring the facility meets production goals while maintaining the highest standards of equipment reliability and team development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the plant’s manufacturing and maintenance operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable production.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance programs, including planning, scheduling, and execution.
* Direct and develop a multidisciplinary team, including Maintenance Planners, Millwrights, Electricians, Mechanics, and Production Supervisors.
* Foster a “Safety First” culture, ensuring compliance with all safety and environmental regulations and serving as a role model for safe industrial behavior.
* Collaborate with other departments (Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, Resources) to align plant performance with company goals and market demands.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices in manufacturing and maintenance to optimize resources and processes.
* Lead and support improvement projects, including research, cost analysis, financial justification, and project management from conception to completion.
* Manage key performance indicators for maintenance and production, such as safety compliance, PM completion, downtime, overtime, expense controls, and plant cleanliness.
* Develop and retain high-performing teams through effective communication, training, and empowerment.
* Build strong relationships across the organization, ensuring active communication and teamwork.
* Utilize modern maintenance management tools (e.g., CMMS, AutoCAD, MS Suite) and interpret technical documents (e.g., blueprints).

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in plant management or senior manufacturing leadership, with a strong track record in maintenance supervision and program development.
* Minimum of five years in maintenance leadership, with hands-on experience in preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance.
* Strong technical skills in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and strong understanding of PLC systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams in a continuous improvement environment.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communicator, able to set clear expectations and drive accountability.
* Experience with process optimization.
* Business acumen to manage budgets, control costs, and justify investments.
* High school diploma required; college-level education in a related field preferred.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**For nearly 100 years, Everbrite** **has been providing innovative visual identification, outdoor signage, indoor signs & displays, menu systems, architectural & drive-thru elements, electronic displays, scoreboards, and LED lighting solutions to leading companies throughout the world.**

As an industry leader, our mission is to understand and exceed our customers’ needs. To that end we believe:

* Our employees are our greatest strength.
* Each product we develop and service is reflective of the great people we hire.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing and dynamic work environment. If this is the environment for you, we would love to talk to you about a career with Everbrite.

**Position Summary:**

The Plant Manager will direct, manage, and coordinate all areas of production, materials, engineering, and related services through managers, supervisors and lead people to achieve timely production of quality products at the most economical cost and in the proper quantities, ensuring on-time delivery. Responsible for the operational improvements of all aspects of the plant production and process controls. Responsible for facility maintenance (building and grounds) and equipment, as well as supervising Environmental/Safety/Quality personnel. Organize and lead the Continuous Improvement Program to include cost savings projects and administration and documentation of the Idea program. Work with management in planning and implementing Quality/Continuous Improvement (QCI) activities.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and manage all production-related departments (including maintenance and prototype) in general administration and enforcement of company rules and regulations. This includes employee selection and development, employee relations, discipline, safety, etc.
* Plan, organize and coordinate manufacturing procedures and operations to accomplish objectives in accordance with production and delivery schedules, skills and manufacturing capacities to maintain profitable operation.
* Provide technical expertise in terms of manufacturing, materials, lead-time, equipment workflow, resources to manufacture new products or improve manufacturing efficiency of existing products, while maintaining or improving quality.
* Control labor and material variances through adequate supervision and cost monitoring.
* Moderate production meetings to assist in planning and making recommendations on matters having to do with manufacturing operations.
* Manage finished goods inventory and warehouse facilities.
* Remain abreast of new manufacturing technology, equipment processes and management techniques through publications, seminars, workshops, or attending related shows or exhibits.
* Conduct timely performance reviews of direct reports, recommending training, changes of wage or status, updating or creating job descriptions, and setting agreeable goals and objectives.
* Maintain an efficient and skilled workforce through formal and informal training and work skill enhancement in order to meet projected workload, advancements in technology and compliance with Quality System requirements.
* Prepare reports and make presentations to members of plant, division and/or corporate management related to production performance.
* Ensure equipment receives regular preventative maintenance and that the plant’s housekeeping exceeds safety standards.
* Develop the most efficient way to employ manpower, machines, materials, information, and energy to manufacture the product or provide a service.
* Develop management control systems and processes to measure productivity, i.e., OEE (Overall Equipment Efficiency), OTD (On Time Delivery), etc.
* Analyze cycle times to improve/increase productivity. Design/improve production planning and control systems and resolve production process problems.
* Study material flow, operations sequence and recommend/implement appropriate changes.
* Evaluate the effects of product design changes.
* Design/improve manufacturing process methods to assure product quality. Assist in setting goals, and planning projects that will meet corporate and plant Quality/CI objectives.
* Oversee the administration of the Ideas program and cost savings projects.
* Assist management in maintaining the Plant within environmental and quality performance regulations.
* Key member of the Safety Committee.
* Assure all plant emergency systems are functioning properly.
* Responsible for developing, communicating, improving, and adhering to safety policies in all work environments and other areas.
* Participate in financial planning, cost/benefit analysis for building, grounds and plant equipment.
* Continue Quality/CI self-education training, Grand Kaizen and participating in other skill enhancement activities.
* Assure that plant personnel are trained and help develop their Quality/CI skills. Conduct Quality/CI skill enhancement sessions.
* Help develop Team Members’ skills; CI, problem solving, Quality, and provide leadership.
* Supervise maintenance department and plan work for maintenance employees, assuring Preventative Maintenance processes are followed. Assist and provide maintenance resources for CI/Kaizen projects.
* Work closely with equipment suppliers, plant staff, and Continuous Improvement Specialist to assure the successful operation of the plant.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Educational Requirements / Experience:**

* Business, manufacturing or engineering-related degree or equivalent years of related work experience. A formal apprenticeship or courses/seminars in supervision would be considered a plus.
* Minimum of 5 years of related production management experience from a similar type manufacturing company or 12 years of management experience from a non-related type of manufacturing.
* Minimum of 5 years’ continuous improvement experience with Lean Enterprise and/or Toyota Production System as demonstrated through participation in and leadership of CI events/projects.
* Possess Quality/CI program certification and/or demonstrate competency.

**Additional Attributes:**

* Excellent verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to utilize Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and E-mail to effectively communicate with others.
* Create presentations as necessary.
* Ability to work with a variety of individuals at all levels.
* Perform basic data analyses as required.
* Create charts, templates, flow maps for standards and clear communication of information.
* Self-motivated.
* Work independently and communicate effectively with others.
* Excellent Project Management skills.
* Lead and manage a team to bring closure to projects.
* Systematic and analytical approach to problem solving.
* Proficient with the concepts and tools of Quality Tools and Lean Manufacturing used in Kaizen analysis.
* Proficient with Value Stream Mapping tools.
* Apply Lean manufacturing tools and train plant associates on various lean tools and techniques, as well as become the resource “expert” for lean methodologies.
* Track and report plant improvement progress.
* Work with team members and supervisors to sustain results by monitoring 30, 60 and 90 day follow up reports.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills with aptitude for facilitating teams and/or activities. Effectively lead a team through an entire event – from training through report-out.
* Show initiative, desire to drive change and motivation to exceed expectations.
* Skilled in statistical knowledge and the ability to apply statistics to product and process improvement projects.
* Competent in Lean principles, including Waste elimination, Pull systems, Kanban, Visual workspace, One Piece Flow, Flow Production, Set-Up Reduction, Standardized Work, Variation Reduction, Error Proofing, Total Productive Maintenance, Ergonomics, Problem Solving, and Level Loading.

**Equal Opportunity Statement:** Everbrite, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Aiken, SC
new_roles.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality & QMS
new_roles.description:
**Job Overview:**

The Senior Manager, Quality & QMS is responsible for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) for Intech’s medical device manufacturing operations.

This position provides senior-level leadership for all site quality activities, including production quality, nonconformance management, CAPA, internal and external audits, supplier quality, document and record control, quality metrics, and continuous improvement. A primary responsibility of the role will be to lead the organization in developing and implementing an effective QMS and preparing the site for ISO 9001 certification.

This position will serve as the primary quality leader for the site and will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, and other functional leaders to ensure that quality is integrated into the business and manufacturing processes rather than operating as a separate inspection function. This role is a hands-on position and will operate strategically while also working directly with manufacturing personnel to establish practical, sustainable quality processes.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System.
* Lead the organization through its ISO 9001 readiness and certification process.
* Establish and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and other QMS documentation.
* Establish effective document and record control processes.
* Develop quality objectives, metrics, and management-review processes.
* Ensure QMS processes are understood, implemented, and effective across the organization.
* Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement and develop practical plans to address them.
* Provide leadership for quality throughout the manufacturing process.
* Establish appropriate inspection, testing, sampling, and process-control requirements.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify and eliminate sources of variation and defects.
* Monitor production quality performance and trends.
* Lead efforts to reduce scrap, rework, defects, and recurring quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate controls are in place for nonconforming product(s), product identification, traceability, and inspection status.
* Support process changes, equipment changes, product introductions, and manufacturing improvements from a quality perspective.
* Own and continuously improve the site's CAPA and nonconformance processes.
* Lead investigations into significant quality issues and recurring nonconformances.
* Establish effective root-cause analysis and corrective-action practices.
* Ensure corrective actions address systemic causes and are implemented and verified for effectiveness.
* Monitor CAPA and NCR trends to identify broader process and systemic issues.
* Establish appropriate escalation of significant quality risks to site leadership.
* Develop and manage the internal audit program.
* Conduct or oversee internal QMS and process audits.
* Coordinate customer, certification, surveillance, and other external audits.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager of Production
new_roles.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:* 
*Gwynedd Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations
new_roles.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
Job Overview

The Operations Director will oversee the company's day to day operations and work closely with leadership to ensure that business objectives are being met. This role is responsible for managing operational performance, supporting department managers, improving internal processes, and making sure teams have the direction and resources they need to do their jobs effectively.

You will work across finance, sales, customer service, and project management to keep business activities organized and running smoothly. The right person understands how to manage people and resources, keep an eye on financial performance, and address operational problems before they affect the business.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and work with department managers to establish priorities, assign responsibilities, and maintain consistent performance across teams.

Monitor profit and loss performance, review operating expenses, and work with finance to manage budgets and improve financial results.

Use financial reports, operational data, and Microsoft Excel to evaluate performance, identify problems, and support day to day business decisions.

Manage operational projects and process improvement initiatives, looking for practical ways to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen service delivery.

Work with sales, business development, and customer service teams to coordinate activities and ensure that operational priorities support the company's business goals.

Review existing procedures and introduce improvements where needed, including the use of lean management principles to improve workflow and resource utilization.

Manage and support department managers, provide clear direction, and follow up on operational responsibilities and performance.

Work with senior leadership on business planning, resource allocation, and decisions that affect the company's operations and long term development.

Address operational challenges, resolve internal coordination issues, and ensure that important projects and business activities stay on track.

Experience and Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, or a related management position, with a strong record of supervising teams and overseeing daily business activities.

Experience managing department managers, coordinating multiple business functions, and maintaining accountability across an organization.

Strong understanding of financial management, profit and loss oversight, operating budgets, and financial performance analysis.

Ability to interpret financial reports, analyze operational data, and use Microsoft Excel to support business decisions.

Experience with strategic planning, project management, process improvement, and operational performance management.

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide managers, develop employees, and address business challenges.

A practical understanding of sales operations, business development, and customer service.

Familiarity with lean management principles and continuous improvement practices is valuable.

Good organizational skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while keeping teams focused on results.

Pay: $158,200.00 - $222,200.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chandler, AZ 85226

new_roles.title: Director Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
The Continuous Improvement Director’s focus is on continuous improvements across Marketing to ensure workflow visualization and prioritization capabilities to improve alignment, increase efficiencies, minimize cost and deliver results. Developing skills and talent focused on Problem Solving and Lean thinking will be a essential part of this role. The position is responsible for creating and implementing process improvement solutions for plans, platforms, and products. This includes establishing metrics to achieve continuous improvement throughout Marketing. The individual works closely with other teams: Branch Operations, Design Engineering, Information Technology, Sales to develop such strategies.

Position Responsibilities:

* Collaborate with Marketing leadership team to facilitate, build and lead the Daikin Comfort Technologies operating system utilizing continuous improvement / Lean principles.
* Drive change culture and provide leadership to ensure Continuous Improvement program success
* Provide mentorship, coaching, and training to the overall Marketing team and process owners with Lean knowledge and tools. Provide feedback, development plans, and recognition to engage your direct reports

* Apply a systematic process to shift individuals, teams, and business units from the current to the desired state. Encourage others to appreciate Help others understand connections within complex issues.
* Influence and support diverse cross-functional teams to identify process improvement opportunities. Ensure support and buy-in to deliver project success.
* Lead, facilitate, and support Actions to drive improvements across Marketing Communications, Experience, Product, and Operations organizations to enable us to reach our growth and productivity metrics.
* Relationship Management & Leadership
* Build talent through a learning environment, helping team members realize their potential

* Establish and foster an environment of Continuous Marketing Process Improvement

* Serve as a key member of the Marketing Operations team and help to execute an aggressive growth strategy which includes significant change management for the development and implementation of Daikin Comfort Technologies Digital Product Development processes and tools.
* Support the vision and strategy that drives continuous improvement in terms of cost reduction (CIP), productivity gains, and best practices to ensure consistent product quality and delivery across all functions and teams.
* Ensure all improvement initiatives support all elements of the organization inclusive of the customer experience and front/back-office operations.
* Provide executive oversight for all Kaizen, Continuous Improvement, and CIP projects.
* Establish and implement a process for standard communication of continuous improvement initiatives across the organization and perform periodic audits to ensure the process is consistent.
* Coordinate and lead meetings for the purpose of selecting improvement projects, report progress on current projects, and maintain standardization of processes.

Nature & scope:

* Develops and implements strategic plans and objectives for the department/sub-function in an effective and innovative fashion.
* Understands the business and can put together comprehensive department solutions.
* Works with other leaders to establish strategic plans and works towards achieving them.
* Provides leadership and direction to managers in their respective division/department.

* Sees department staffing needs (e.g., interviewing, hiring, new hire and ongoing training, annual evaluations, etc.)

* Participates in budget development and monitoring of expenses.

* Level of signing authority established by company policy/guidelines.

Knowledge & Skills:

* Track record of successful project management and team leadership experience.

* Strong knowledge of quality and design engineering, manufacturing, specifications, testing, and inspections.

* Superior interpersonal & communication skills with a unique ability to influence people, articulate ideas, and lead highly productive technical teams.

* Executive presence and demonstrated leadership characteristics of self-motivation, confidence, influence, integrity, and professional savvy.

* Ability to quantify results, lead change, and interface with all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated proficiency in the MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel), MS Project, Visio, etc.

Competencies:

Experience:

* 10 or more years of process/quality improvement experience
* Strong business management skills and process/quality improvement experience

Education/Certification:

* A degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field from a four-year college or university is required. An advanced degree is highly preferred.

People Management:

* Yes

Physical Requirements / Work Environment:

* Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations

Reports To:

* Director, Marketing Operations

The Company provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of a person’s race, color, religion (including religious dress or grooming practices), creed, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, uniform service member or veteran status, ancestry, disability, physical or mental disability (including HIV/AIDS), medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, request for protected leave, marital status, sex, pregnancy, age (over 40), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by law. The Company will comply with all federal and state regulations and statutes about individuals with disabilities.

new_roles.title: Director - Service Operations
new_roles.description:
As the **Director of Service Operations** at Lumos, you'll play a critical leadership role in delivering reliable fiber connectivity and an exceptional customer experience across our growing markets. You'll lead and develop regional operations teams, oversee service installations and maintenance, and drive the performance, safety, and efficiency of our field operations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Lumos continues to expand, combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational expertise to strengthen service delivery, improve processes, and build high-performing teams that support our customers and continued growth.

This is a remote position supporting Service Operations across the Midwest region, with a preference for candidates located within a Lumos market in **Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky**. Regional travel is required.

**Why Lumos:**

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead, coach, and develop regional Service Operations managers and teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a strong customer-first culture.
* Oversee service installations, maintenance, and field operations across assigned markets, ensuring consistent quality, safety, and operational performance.
* Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and customer experience metrics to drive efficiency, service reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute operational strategies that support market expansion, service delivery objectives, and long-term business growth.
* Manage department budgets, resources, and operational projects to ensure effective planning, execution, and cost management.
* Oversee vendor and contractor performance, including negotiations, service expectations, and accountability for operational results.
* Serve as a key escalation point for complex customer and operational challenges, driving timely resolution and improvements to the customer experience.
* Partner across Network Operations, Engineering, Construction, Customer Care, and other teams to improve workflows, strengthen service delivery, and support business objectives.
* Establish and maintain operational policies, procedures, and safety standards while identifying opportunities to improve processes and scale operations.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of experience in telecommunications service operations, field operations, or a related area.
* Proven experience leading geographically dispersed teams, developing managers, and driving operational performance across multiple markets.
* Strong understanding of telecommunications service installation, maintenance, network operations, and customer service delivery.
* Experience managing operational budgets, vendor relationships, contractor performance, and service-level agreements.
* Ability to analyze KPIs, operational performance, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational software platforms, with the ability to adapt to new systems and technologies.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and lead effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**What Makes You a Great Fit:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in business, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field.
* Direct experience in the fiber broadband or FTTH industry, including distributed and centralized split network architectures.
* Knowledge of central office infrastructure, network equipment, and telecommunications facilities.
* Experience improving customer satisfaction, NPS scores, and operational efficiency across multiple markets.
* A track record of developing high-performing teams, improving operational processes, and supporting growth in a scaling organization.
* A collaborative, hands-on leadership style with the ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Frequently operates a computer, phone, and standard office tools.
* Ability to travel to properties and regional offices as needed.
* Near-constant use of sight, speech, hearing, comprehension, and reasoning.
* Must be able to sit or remain in a stationary position for extended periods.

**Benefits & Perks:**

Our commitment to communities includes recruiting and rewarding the Lumos team members who are working together to build a brighter tomorrow.

We have:

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive compensation packages, including bonus options for eligible positions.
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays.
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs).
* 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to professional support for life's challenges.
* 401K plan w/ up to 5% employer contribution and a self-directed brokerage option.
* Wellness program offering education and cash incentives for gym attendance and nutrition programs.
* Employee referral bonuses.
* Discounts on Lumos Fiber Internet for employees who live in our service areas.
* Discounts on T-Mobile wireless service and select features for lines.

**Applicant Eligibility Notice:** 
Applicants must be at least eighteen (18) years of age at the time of application.

**At Lumos we recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We have a longstanding policy of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual and is free from all forms of employment discrimination, including harassment, because of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals** **with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief, in accordance with applicable laws.**

new_roles.title: Director of Production
new_roles.description:
MHI Ship Repair & Services is a major marine repair and conversion contractor serving the U.S. Navy, Military Sealift Command, Maritime Administration and Commercial ship owners and operators worldwide. Our shipyard is conveniently located in the Mid-Atlantic region at the port of Hampton Roads, Norfolk Virginia.

**JOB SUMMARY:** Manages the operations of all production trades to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and the work efforts are coordinated and executed in a cost-effective manner, safely, and on time. Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.

**SUPERVISES:** All Shop Superintendents

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Primary oversight of all production departments to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for making strategic and tactical decisions related to certain aspects of MHI's production business to include operation non-Program work
* Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and that work efforts are prioritized, coordinated and efforts integrated between departments and executed safely, in a cost-effective manner and on time.
* Ensures performance is within the guidelines of the contracts, delivery orders are received and that all contractual requirements are within the scope of work for the specific market and are met for U.S. Navy, Government, private shipyard, and commercial projects.
* Holds daily production meetings with all trades and Project Managers. Communicate with all department heads to ensure that any manning, scheduling, tooling, and material issues are identified and resolved.
* Attend all SRA Production Meetings.
* Walks through all in plant vessels daily verifying all work in progress and identifying and resolving any issues as they arise.
* Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.
* Reviews and proofreads specs.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Estimating as requested.
* May on occasion be required to manage a project.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by supervisor.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* College education and 15 years progressive experience in the maritime industry. (Apprenticeship and practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.) Prior management experience a must.
* Ability to estimate.
* Basic knowledge of all skilled trades, and ability to manage effectively.
* Ability to communicate effectively as a leader.

MHI Ship Repair & Services offers competitive wages and an excellent benefit package.

Affirmative Action/EOE Employer of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

new_roles.company: Circle of Life Home Care Anishinaabe
new_roles.title: Regional Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Circle of Life is growing, and we have an opening for a Regional Director of Operations to join our team. This position will oversee and manage our New Mexico branches; Albuquerque, Gallup, Kirtland, Shiprock, and Zuni.

**Good for employees**

Circle of Life’s focus is creating a workplace where respect, appreciation and teamwork are the shared experiences of our team. We do good for our employees by collaborating on scheduling, a focus on wellbeing, a client-first directive, respecting and valuing every team member, having fun along with top industry compensation and benefits.

**Good deeds**

We also do good in our work. Our team of office and field staff care about each other and the clients we serve. We help one another. We care and provide for a wide range of patients with a focus on serving the underserved.

**Position duties include**

* Participate in the hiring and training of managers
* Organize and oversee the work and schedules of managers
* Conduct performance evaluations
* Handle discipline of employees as needed following company policy
* Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics, guidelines, and standards by which the company's efficiency and effectiveness can be evaluated (identify opportunities for improvement)
* Implement policies and procedures that will improve day-to-day operations
* Oversee office operations, ensuring each branch is reaching goals set by departmental and company leadership
* Monitors budget and revenue in each office to achieve financial objectives
* Communicates and explains new directives, policies/procedures to manager for change and meets with staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale
* Improve customer service and satisfaction
* Market current products to potential clients, families, case workers and potential referral sources
* Leads coordination and integration of efforts among homecare teams to produce smoother workflow and more cost-effective business processes
* Traveling is required

**Qualifications**

Qualified applicants will have 3 years of management experience, excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal and customer service skills. Healthcare and/or home care experience preferred. The Regional Director of Operations oversees the day-to-day activities for their assigned branches, ensuring the organization is managed and performing efficiently and effectively. While carrying out the responsibilities of the position, ensure the values of servant-leadership, empathy, altruism, and integrity are evident in all actions and encounters.

**How good?**

* Positively change the lives of individuals and families in our communities
* Serve the underserved providing access to care for those who have been traditionally overlooked by the health care system
* Support a talented team of administrative and clinical professionals and be a part of a team that supports each other

**Full Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental, 401K, Paid Holidays, Top PTO Plan, Mileage, Flexible Schedules, Vision, Year-End Bonus

new_roles.title: Director of Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
Job Summary - Why you’ll love this position

Are you motivated by the challenge of solving complex, enterprise-wide problems? Do you love asking "why" and transforming good operations into exceptional public experiences? If so, consider joining the State of Missouri as our next Director of Operational Excellence!

In this pivotal leadership role you will champion continuous improvement across state government, lead our operational initiatives, and oversee our statewide customer experience program. This position resides within the Office of Administration, the administrative arm of the executive branch, but leads efforts that span all executive agencies to improve service delivery to the citizens of Missouri.

We are seeking an energetic, visionary executive to lead and empower a dedicated team of process improvement and customer experience efforts while serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership, agency partners, and frontline public servants. Our next director is a bridge-builder who combines proven improvement methodologies with human-centered design, modern customer experience principles, rapid responsiveness to agency partner needs, and a passion for coaching state team members to achieve measurable public outcomes.

In addition to the inspiring work that will improve the services provided by state government and your colleagues work environment, you will receive a great benefits package that includes paid time off, medical/vision/dental insurance, life insurance, and retirement.

*The salary indicated represents a base pay rate. If the individual selected or the position is eligible for a pay differential (e.g., shift, security, or years of service), it will be added to the total compensation in your paycheck. A pay differential does not raise your base pay.*

Responsibilities - What you’ll do

* Work collaboratively with leadership and teams to encourage, develop, and execute strategies to create a culture of continuous improvement across Missouri state government. Measure the effectiveness of improvements and provide administration with visibility to such improvements.
* Act as a subject matter expert and promote change management by sharing Lean Six Sigma and other Operational Excellence best practices. Teach, mentor, coach and lead Operational Excellence leaders from every state department.
* Continuously provide helpful operational excellence resources for team members and facilitate training sessions.
* Model excellence in leadership and act with urgency to achieve results and lead efforts to cultivate a culture of data-based decision making.
* Facilitate, lead, and oversee state level strategic initiatives and other projects as assigned by leadership.
* Coordinate and host an annual Show Me Excellence Summit and represent the State of Missouri at national operational excellence events.

Qualifications - All you need for success

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Formal training in Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent continuous process improvement framework. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge in Lean and Operational Excellence frameworks and facilitation methodologies
* Hands-on experience work with survey, feedback, or data visualization platforms, such as Qualtrics, Tableau, or Power BI

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Must be action oriented, demonstrate superior organizational abilities and have strong facilitation skills and excellent communications skills.
* Ability to work with leaders and multi-level teams to establish goals, performance indicators, actions plans and deliverables and effectively communicating across broad audiences.
* Must have excellent leadership abilities. This individual must be an effective collaborator with energy, enthusiasm and a can-do attitude who can empower others, gain buy-in and achieve results.
* Good understanding of data analysis related to process improvement and an ability to analyze data to gain insights and support problem solving.
* Training, certification, and/or education in continuous process improvement programs such as Lean Six Sigma as well as completion of Missouri Way, Leadership Academy, and similar programs is preferred.

***Lack of post******‐******secondary education will not be used as the sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.***

Successful background check results are required for employment in this position. This may include background checks involving a candidate's name and/or fingerprints and other screenings as needed for the specific position.

Authorization to work in the United States is a prerequisite of employment. The Office of Administration will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Job Details - More reasons to love this position

The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. To help demonstrate the value of working for the State of Missouri, we have created an interactive Total Compensation Calculator. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

Contact Details - If you have questions or require any accommodations to participate in the application or interview process please contact:

OARecruiters@oa.mo.gov

The State of Missouri is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to developing and maintaining a talented workforce.
