Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

LeoLabs is seeking a Head of Manufacturing to lead the next phase of production scaling of our radar systems. This leader will own the manufacturing strategy, industrialization roadmap, quality management, facility scaling, and cross-functional execution required to increase production capacity beyond 10x. This role may be leveled as Senior Director or Vice President level based on the successful candidate’s experience, leadership scope and demonstrated ability to own the function. The role with report directly to the SVP, Radars. This role is a full-time, in-person position based at our headquarters in Menlo Park, CA. Regular domestic travel is expected.

The Head of Manufacturing will turn LeoLabs’ advanced radar designs from low/medium-rate initial production into repeatable, scalable, high-rate production systems. You will collaborate with and leverage support from Product, Supply Chain, Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering, Program Management, Finance and Accounting, and executive leadership to build the manufacturing capacity that enables LeoLabs to deploy radar systems more reliably and at greater scale for the U.S. Government, allies, and commercial customers.

The preferred candidate has done this before – they are a leader who has built and sustained a manufacturing system, rather than someone who has only managed an existing operation. This candidate is a hands-on manufacturing executive or emerging executive from a high-performance production environment such as aerospace, defense technology, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. They have scaled production systems from the ground up, built functional teams, improved quality, stood up facilities or production lines, and operated with urgency in environments where reliability, repeatability, and mission success matter.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Strategy & Scale

* Own LeoLabs’ high-rate manufacturing and industrialization strategy for radar systems, subsystems, and associated high-reliability hardware across manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test operations.
* Build and scale a production system and team capable of supporting 10x growth in radar production over the next 2 years while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, integration, and deployment readiness.
* Define the operating model across internal manufacturing, external suppliers, contract manufacturing, and integration partners.
* Own the high-rate production footprint plan including facility needs, equipment, tooling, staffing, and capital investment.
* Stand up scalable production lines, work cells, fixtures, test stations, documentation, and acceptance processes for radar hardware, RF systems, electronics, electromechanical assemblies, power systems, compute infrastructure, and system-level integration.
* Establish the scaled manufacturing steady state including production planning, throughput management, capacity planning, cost analysis, quality, and delivery execution.

Industrialization

* Own the transition from engineering builds to production-ready designs.
* Establish and mature release and readiness gates, first-article processes, and build documentation.
* Partner with Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering teams to industrialize new radar designs, ensuring manufacturability, testability, serviceability, configuration control, and production readiness.
* Partner with engineering NPI manufacturing team to improve manufacturability, DfX, and cost reduction opportunities.
* Ensure new radar products have validated build plans, test procedures, tooling, factory acceptance testing criteria, and supplier plans before production ramp.
* Create a functioning feedback system from manufacturing and sustainment back into product and engineering.

Quality, Reliability & Production

* Build and mature the quality management system required for high-reliability radar systems serving mission-critical customers.
* Establish clear standards for configuration control, traceability, inspection, nonconformance management, corrective action, supplier quality, and production acceptance.
* Drive measurable improvements in yield, first-pass quality, rework, scrap, field defects, and schedule performance.
* Build strong review mechanisms for failures, escapes, production risks, and systemic issues.
* Partner with Technical Program Management to align production readiness and execution with program, contract, customer, and deployment commitments
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier readiness, long-lead planning, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with the Radar Operations Center and Global Infrastructure to turn field performance and maintenance data into product and process improvements to increase performance, reduce operational impacts, and decrease maintenance costs.
* Develop manufacturing KPIs and high-level dashboards for throughput, schedule metrics, yield, labor tracking, cost, quality, rework, scrap, supplier performance, and field reliability.

Team Leadership

* Establish and lead the LeoLabs Production System, creating a common operating model for safety, quality, delivery, cost and people. Implement tiered daily management, visual controls, standard work, structured problem solving, leader standard work, production flow, capacity management and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a world-class manufacturing organization including manufacturing operations, production, test operations, quality, facilities, and related functions.
* Set clear ownership and metrics across the manufacturing organization.
* Build a culture of execution, urgency, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production operations, industrialization, factory operations, manufacturing engineering, or related operational leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and leading a mature Lean manufacturing or production operating system, such as the Toyota Production System, including standard work, visual management, daily accountability, structured problem solving, flow, built-in quality, waste reduction and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience scaling production capacity, standing up production lines or facilities, and improving throughput, quality, cost, and delivery performance.
* Experience manufacturing complex, high-reliability hardware in industries such as aerospace, defense, automotive, advanced electronics, robotics, industrial automation, energy systems, RF systems, communications, space systems, or mission-critical infrastructure.
* Experience with quality management systems and standards such as AS9100, ISO 9001, IPC standards, ESD controls, supplier quality, first-article inspection
* Strong technical fluency with hardware product development, NPI, configuration control, test operations, production readiness, and root-cause corrective action.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain required U.S. security clearances, as applicable to this role.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, industrial engineering, supply chain, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Formal training or demonstrated practitioner experience in Toyota Production System, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent operating system. Black Belt, Master Black Belt, TPS practitioner/trainer or comparable credentials preferred.
* Experience developing greenfield or brownfield production facilities, production lines, integration sites, or manufacturing cells.
* Experience with radar, RF systems, antennas, communications systems, sensors, satellites, ground systems, aerospace systems, or other complex electromechanical products.
* Experience supporting Department of War, Space Force, NASA, or allied government customers.
* Experience working with classified, export-controlled, ITAR/EAR-controlled, or otherwise sensitive hardware programs.
* Master’s degree in engineering, operations, business administration, manufacturing, supply chain, or a related discipline.

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to San Francisco Bay Area with a base salary range of $225,000 - $248,000, plus bonus, equity, and benefits.

Compensation Note: The salary range for this position is benchmarked based on the designated primary work location for the role. Final compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s work location, applicable market data, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Perks and Benefits

* Global workforce: flexible remote/hybrid opportunities
* Work on complex, meaningful missions with real-world impact
* Unlimited paid time off for most roles
* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Access to the forefront of commercial space operations and defense innovation

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International

Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the

U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC's website.

Pay: $225,000.00 - $248,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule

**Plant Manager**
=================

**Atlas Roofing Corporation | East Moline, IL**

### **Lead Operations. Drive Performance. Build a Culture of Excellence.**

Atlas Roofing Corporation is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Plant Manager** to lead operations at our East Moline, Illinois manufacturing facility.

This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, drives operational excellence, and inspires teams to achieve outstanding results.

The Plant Manager will have overall responsibility for plant performance, including safety, production, quality, engineering, maintenance, inventory, customer service, and financial results. The ideal candidate brings strong operational leadership, a continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day execution.

### **What You'll Do**

**Plant Operations & Performance**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, ensuring performance targets for safety, quality, production, delivery, reliability, and cost are achieved.
* Drive operational efficiency, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement to maximize productivity and profitability.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), identify performance gaps, and implement corrective actions.
* Oversee production scheduling, inventory management, and resource allocation to meet customer demand and tight delivery timelines.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, develop, and lead a high-performing manufacturing team focused on accountability, collaboration, and results.
* Coach and mentor employees, establish clear performance expectations, and develop future leaders.
* Foster a positive, safety-focused workplace culture aligned with Atlas Roofing's core values.
* Lead organizational change and implement sustainable operational improvements.

**Financial & Strategic Management**

* Manage plant budgets, operating expenses, and financial performance to achieve business objectives.
* Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives while maintaining quality and service standards.
* Evaluate capital investment opportunities, oversee equipment upgrades, and manage major plant improvement projects.
* Partner with sales, engineering, and corporate leadership to align manufacturing capabilities with business priorities.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Champion a proactive safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.
* Maintain effective quality management systems and drive improvements in product consistency and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure plant facilities, equipment, and assets are properly maintained, protected, and operated efficiently.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of **10 years of manufacturing experience**, preferably in a technologically advanced or chemical process manufacturing environment.
* At least **4 years of manufacturing leadership experience** with responsibility for operational performance and team development.
* Proven ability to manage production, safety, quality, maintenance, and operational efficiency.
* Strong financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, controlling costs, and analyzing manufacturing performance.
* Demonstrated experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, and organizational skills.
* Hands-on, results-oriented leadership style with the ability to drive accountability and positive change.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing ERP systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* MBA or advanced business education.
* Plant-level profit-and-loss (P&L) management experience.
* Experience in chemical processing, continuous manufacturing, or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Proven success leading operational improvements, capital projects, and manufacturing transformation initiatives.

### **Why Join Atlas Roofing?**

At Atlas Roofing Corporation, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by leading people, improving processes, and driving manufacturing performance.

We're looking for a leader who takes ownership, embraces challenges, and is passionate about building successful teams and sustainable operational results.

**Ready to lead the next chapter of manufacturing excellence? Apply today and explore your future with Atlas Roofing Corporation.**

*Atlas Roofing Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.*

existing_roles.description:
CAMS is looking for a Plant Manager at the Kings Mountain Energy Center in Kings Mountain, NC. The incumbent will have 19 direct and indirect employees. The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, compliant, and financially responsible operation and maintenance of the Kings Mountain Energy Center.

Kings Mountain Energy Center is a 475MW natural gas-fired combined-cycle power plant. The facility features an advanced 276MW Mitsubishi M501GAC gas turbine, a Vogt Power heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), a 225MW Toshiba steam turbine generator, and a Thermal Engineering International surface condenser.

The position provides overall leadership for plant operations, maintenance, engineering support, environmental and regulatory compliance, administration, workforce development, budgeting, outage execution, and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager serves as the primary site representative to CAMS leadership, facility ownership and asset management, and is accountable for developing a high-performing organization that maximizes plant availability, reliability, efficiency, and long-term asset value. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, sound technical and business judgment, and the ability to manage a complex combined-cycle generating facility in a competitive power-market environment.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost-effective operation and maintenance of the facility.
* Establish and maintain a strong safety culture in which employees and contractors actively identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and demonstrate personal ownership of safety performance.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental permits, laws, regulations, NERC requirements, OSHA requirements, company policies, and facility procedures.
* Lead and develop the plant management team and workforce, including recruiting, coaching, performance management, succession planning, qualification programs, and workforce development.
* Maintain effective working relationships with facility ownership, Asset Management, CAMS leadership, regulatory agencies, the system operator, utilities, OEMs, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, O&M budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and long-term maintenance strategies consistent with owner objectives and contractual requirements.
* Monitor plant financial performance and control expenditures while ensuring that short-term budget objectives do not create unacceptable safety, environmental, reliability, or long-term asset risk.
* Direct plant operations to achieve availability, reliability, heat-rate, start-reliability, capacity, and other performance objectives while meeting dispatch and commercial obligations.
* Provide leadership for maintenance strategies, preventive and predictive maintenance, corrective-maintenance backlog management, equipment reliability, root-cause analysis, and elimination of recurring failures.
* Direct planning and execution of combustion turbine, steam turbine, HRSG, generator, electrical, and balance-of-plant outages and major maintenance activities, including scope, budget, schedule, contractor performance, quality, and risk management.
* Develop and maintain multi-year outage, major-maintenance, and capital improvement plans based on equipment condition, OEM recommendations, operating profile, commercial requirements, and risk.
* Identify significant plant risks and provide CAMS leadership and ownership with timely information, alternatives, consequences, and clear recommendations for decision-making.
* Ensure appropriate critical-spares strategy, inventory controls, long-lead component planning, and equipment-obsolescence management.
* Oversee plant engineering and technical support activities, including equipment modifications, controls and logic changes, performance monitoring, capital projects, and technical problem solving.
* Ensure plant procedures, drawings, technical documentation, training materials, emergency plans, and operating records are accurate and maintained.
* Oversee administration of applicable plant contracts and agreements and ensure operational compliance with owner requirements, O&M obligations, OEM/LTSA requirements, fuel and utility agreements, and other commercial commitments.
* Maintain effective communication with Asset Management and ownership, including prompt escalation of significant safety, environmental, operational, equipment, financial, contractual, or regulatory events.
* Lead emergency response and business-continuity activities and ensure the facility is prepared for severe weather, grid emergencies, fuel interruptions, cyber events, and major equipment failures.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and open communication across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Compliance, and Administration.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve plant performance, reduce operating risk, optimize costs, and increase long-term asset value.
* Support CAMS fleet initiatives, peer reviews, lessons learned, workforce-development efforts, and cross-facility technical support as requested.

Other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in power generation operations and maintenance, including significant leadership experience in a power plant environment.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Maintenance Manager, or comparable senior power-generation leadership experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of combined-cycle power plant operations, maintenance, reliability, and major equipment systems. Experience with combustion turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, electrical systems, and balance-of-plant equipment is preferred.
* Experience with Mitsubishi M501GAC combustion turbines is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing major outages, managing contractors and OEMs, controlling outage scope and cost, and resolving emergent technical issues.
* Working knowledge of environmental, health and safety, and electric-generation regulatory requirements applicable to power plant operations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and managing O&M budgets, forecasts, capital projects, and long-term maintenance plans.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary workforce.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, planning, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, executives, owners, regulators, contractors, and technical personnel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. Significant relevant power-generation leadership experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems, plant historians, performance-monitoring systems, and other power-plant business systems.
* Ability to respond to plant emergencies and significant operating events outside normal business hours as required.

Other Desirable Skills

* Demonstrates visible leadership and a strong personal commitment to safety and environmental compliance.
* Balances technical, operational, financial, and commercial considerations when making decisions.
* Communicates significant risks and problems early and avoids surprises for ownership and senior leadership.
* Demonstrates strong customer service skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with facility ownership and Asset Management.
* Effectively prioritizes competing demands in a fast-changing operating environment.
* Develop people and create clear succession paths for key positions.
* Demonstrates a high degree of integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and ownership mentality.
* Ability to represent the facility and CAMS professionally with owners, regulators, industry organizations, and external stakeholders

Applicants must possess a **valid driver's license** and maintain a clean driving record, as this position requires occasional travel for company business. Candidates should be comfortable operating a vehicle as part of their job responsibilities and must meet any applicable company and insurance requirements.

CAMS offers a variety of excellent benefits. Full-time employees are offered the following: medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, and Life insurance plans. You can even select additional “al la carte” benefits to meet all your needs. You can also enroll in our 401k, flex spending accounts for medical and childcare needs, and participate in our employee referral and tuition reimbursement programs.

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

We believe in transparency and providing candidates with important information to make informed decisions. The salary range for this position will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, and relevant qualifications.

This range represents the base salary and does not include other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, benefits, or equity, which may be offered in addition to the base pay. The company reserves the right to modify.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**SUMMARY:** Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**:

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES**:

The individual must posses the following:

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS**:

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

* **Operating standards** - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.

all in-process production metrics as deliverables are being met. This team member will be focused

Job Duties & Responsibilities:  

* Establishing and maintaining production and shipping schedules and ensuring that quality

product is consistently delivered to customers on time and within budget for labor hours,
  
machine hours and material costs  

* Managing production operations such that equipment and employee resources are

utilized efficiently, productivity is high and product quality requirements are met and
  
exceeded  

* Ensuring that process and equipment capabilities meet or exceed company and industry

standards and requirements; implementing operations-related initiatives that result in
  
increased efficiency, improved productivity and reduced job-related costs  

* Full participation in weekly production meetings and daily work-related meetings is

expected  

* Maintaining company policies and procedures with respect to production, materials, and

equipment-related activities, ensuring that employees report labor hours, machine hours,
  
material usage and activities in accordance with company policies and procedures and
  
within the current operations management and control systems  

* Implementing operations and function-related budgeting goals and objectives;

establishing benchmarks for monthly, quarterly, and annual case production and
  
shipments, material receipts, production work-in-process completed and inventory levels
  
within the Plant Level of Operations  

* Preparing and presenting to Director of Operations, the weekly executive summary that

includes production, purchasing, shipping, receiving and inventory numbers as part of the
  
system of infernal checks and balances  

* Recruiting, selecting, training, motivating and evaluating all operations employees in

accordance with company human relations policies and procedures  

* Helping to build and manage within a team-based production environment and developing

and maintaining good working relationships between production, materials, and
  
equipment maintenance  

* Interfacing between the employees in the department and the Director of Operations, the

Executive Vice-President and President of the Company and supporting company policies,
  
goals, objectives, and initiatives  

* Ensuring that all product produced meets quality requirements in accordance with

company policy, procedures and requirements and in accordance with industry standards  

* Keeping the Management abreast of successes, progress and potential problems and

offering appropriate solutions for those problems  

* Simultaneously handling, prioritizing and resolving problems effectively
* Ensuring that shipment deadlines and budget and profitability objectives (i.e. gross margin

and operating profit) are met and exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis as established
  
by Director of Operations  

* Ensuring achievement of production metrics and shipment objectives, including labor

hours per case, machine time per case, quality and cost per case; ensure that labor and
  
machine efficiency is within company guidelines; ensuring that periodic maintenance,
  
repair, rework hours and waste are within company guidelines  

* Ascertaining that purchasing, production support, shipping and receiving performance

metrics and objectives and inventory units and balance objectives are achieved or
  
exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis while ensuring on-time delivery of quality
  
product to customers at budgeted cost per case

maintained between production, materials and equipment maintenance personnel, with
  
engineering and sales, customers, subcontractors and others in the area and in the
  
industry  

* Ensuring customer complaints are fewer and of less seriousness than company targets and

objectives  

* Ensuring that reporting and supporting documentation is completed on time and in

accordance with company procedures  

* Achieving Company goals to produce quality product on time and within budget hours are

supported in theory and followed in practice

* 5+ year’s relevant industrial and manufacturing experience
* Associates degree in industrial, mechanical, or electrical engineering or equivalent

experience. Manufacturing engineering and operations management an added plus  

* Relevant and current technical knowledge concerning products, materials and equipment
* Knowledge, skills and ability to understand and manage food processing activities and

production lines to provide expertise and technical support to all plant employees, to
  
make equipment, production and materials related decisions  

* Ability to maintain production planning and scheduling, shop loading, expediting and

dispatching, purchasing, shipping and receiving and inventory control functions using
  
manufacturing systems in place  

* Ability to lead and motivate teams to produce quality product, on schedule and within

budget and participate in and facilitate operations-related team meetings  

* Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to successfully lead and develop a

team  

* Excellent team leadership skills and an ability to set goals, accomplish objectives, coach

and counsel while adding to the organizational climate and culture  

* Personal characteristics reflective of a fast paced industry: high energy, self-motivated,

positive attitude, service oriented, flexible, ethical, loyal and with high degree of integrity  

* Business maturity, team orientation and proven ability to positively influence change and

ensure business discipline through periods of growth while simultaneously protecting the
  
company’s operating principles and underlying entrepreneurial culture  

* Demonstrated good judgment in prioritizing, expediting, investigating and resolving

problems and issues and fosters harmonious relations with other company employees
  
while meeting and exceeding customer requirements  

* Respect for the confidentiality of company, customer, and employee information

Competencies:  

* Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process

improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff;
  
Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages
  
growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus
  
in others; Improves processes, products, and services.; Continually works to improve
  
supervisory skills.

correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values; Benefits organization

At Ecore, we transform reclaimed rubber into innovative performance surfaces that protect people and the planet. Our products power everything from playgrounds and gyms to hospitals, courts, and even rockets—helping people in motion be their strongest, healthiest selves. As a high-growth, sustainability-driven company, we’re leading the way in circular innovation by keeping rubber out of landfills and turning waste into wellness, safety, and performance. We’re excited to find individuals who are eager to be part of a team that’s driving global impact through innovation, sustainability, and purpose.
  
  
**Location:** 715 Fountain Avenue, Lancaster, PA 17601
  
  
Lead a High-Performing Manufacturing Operation and Drive Operational Excellence
  
Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives on building strong teams, improving performance, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement? We are seeking a Plant Manager to lead all aspects of site operations, including safety, quality, delivery, cost, maintenance, and employee development.
  
This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact in a close-knit manufacturing environment where leadership matters, employee engagement is valued, and continuous improvement is part of the culture. We're looking for a servant leader who is willing to roll up their sleeves, develop people, challenge the status quo, and drive measurable business results.
  
What You'll Do
  
As Plant Manager, you will have full responsibility for the performance of the facility and will lead efforts to achieve world-class results in:
  

* Safety performance and employee engagement
* Product quality and customer satisfaction
* On-time delivery and schedule attainment
* Cost control and operational efficiency
* Maintenance and facility reliability
* Continuous improvement and Lean manufacturing initiatives

You will lead a team of supervisors and managers while partnering closely with Planning, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Customer Service, and Finance to ensure the site consistently meets customer expectations and business objectives.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Lead daily plant operations to ensure safety, quality, delivery, and cost targets are achieved.
* Develop, coach, and mentor supervisors and department leaders.
* Foster a culture built on accountability, trust, teamwork, and servant leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 6S, and other operational excellence tools.
* Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC).
* Oversee production scheduling, capacity planning, labor utilization, and inventory management.
* Ensure maintenance programs support operational reliability and uptime.
* Manage plant budgets, capital projects, labor expenses, and maintenance costs.
* Conduct regular Gemba walks, safety reviews, audits, and performance discussions.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, and company safety standards.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Planning teams to support customer demand and on-time delivery goals.

What We're Looking For
  
Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent manufacturing leadership experience.
* 10+ years of manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or comparable site leader.
* Proven success leading salaried supervisors and managers in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated track record of improving safety, quality, delivery, and cost metrics.
* Experience working with ERP/MRP systems for production scheduling, inventory, and shop floor operations.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing labor, maintenance, and capital budgets.
* Knowledge of production scheduling, capacity planning, and manufacturing operations.
* Working knowledge of OSHA and environmental compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication and team leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience leading operational turnarounds or transformational change initiatives.
* Background in manufacturing environments involving assembly, metal fabrication, sheet metal, packaging, mechanical components, fasteners, or related industrial products.
* Experience driving cultural transformation and employee engagement initiatives.

**The successful candidate will be:**  

* A servant leader who develops people and builds strong teams.
* A culture builder capable of leading organizational change.
* A proactive problem solver who challenges convention and drives improvement.
* A leader who creates accountability rather than simply managing tasks.
* Equally comfortable on the production floor and in strategic planning discussions.
* Focused on measurable results while maintaining a people-first approach.

* Opportunity to lead a highly visible manufacturing operation.
* Strong support from executive leadership.
* Collaborative, team-oriented culture.
* Ability to drive operational improvements and leave a lasting impact.
* Opportunity to develop employees, strengthen culture, and improve business performance.

Apply today and become the leader who drives the next chapter of operational excellence.

**Purpose**
  
Under minimal supervisor, manages the daily, on-going production operations of an assigned plant(s). Oversees plant personnel providing guidance and direction to lower level management. Drives customer focused business strategy through maintaining optimal plant operation and accurate inventory management.
  
  
**Focus & Scope**
  
*Essential duties and responsibilities, i.e. those which are basic, necessary, and an integral part of the job, are indicated below:*

* Oversees the daily aggregate mining, processing and asphalt operations at an assigned plant(s).

* Manages assigned staff to include: hiring, training, and development. Determines workflow and staff priorities.

* Conducts business in a professional, legal and environmentally sound manner in adherence to company policies.

* Analyzes financial and operational plant performance including operating margin, cost, key production indicators, and inventory management.

* Administers short and long range plant planning, coordinates production schedules and costs, as well as plant flow evaluation, maintenance and inventory control.

* Ensures that plants are in good operating condition at all times and proposes changes and modifications as required. Maximizes efficiencies through systems and automation.

* Collaborates with the Engineering Department to develop capital expenditure analysis for plant improvements.

* Confers with sales personnel in preparation of annual sales budgets.

* Determines annual plant operating budget and manages to budget.

* Monitors union contracts for workforce and company compliance. May participate in union/company contract negotiations.

* Develops a Zero Injury culture by setting expectations, coaching behavior, and adhering to all company safety policies and practices.

  
**Qualifications, Requirements, & Competencies**
  
  
Education

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Construction Management or Business or an equivalent combination of training, education and experience.

  
Experience & Industry Expertise:

* A minimum of five (5) years of experience in an aggregate or asphalt environment or an equivalent combination of training and related experience. An advanced understanding of Aggregate plant operations and products.

  
Specific Job Requirements:

* Three (3) years experience managing staff.
* Must demonstrate ability to effectively lead, manage, coach, mentor and develop staff.
* Must demonstrate ability to formulate and implement new or improved processes, procedures or tactics.
* Must demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize and manage multiple assignments.
* Must demonstrate the ability to originate and drive operation initiatives, changes and enhancements.
* Must develop and maintain strong working relationships internally and externally with diverse groups of people.
* Must possess excellent verbal and written communications skills with the ability to speak, write and understand English at a proficient and understandable level.
* Must demonstrate the ability work well under pressure, remaining composed and professional. Must demonstrate strong organizational skills and time management practices.
* Must be able to maintain a high level of confidentiality.
* Must have advanced knowledge of computer software programs including Word, Excel and Outlook; familiar with department specific programs such as Oracle, JD Edwards and JWS.
* Must possess a valid California Driver License and must maintain an acceptable driving record when driving is a job requirement.

  
Competencies

* Building Successful Teams
* Safe Work Ethic
* Communication
* Judgment/Decision-Making
* Managing Complexity
* Strategic Thinking

  
**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

* Physical Demands: Employees occasionally may experience the following physical demands for extended periods of time: Viewing of computer monitor. Keyboarding; use of fingers to make small movements such as typing and mouse usage. Driving to plant sites, other offices or meeting sites. Position may require lifting of materials and equipment up to 10 lbs. May require walking on uneven ground, climbing, reaching, bending or stooping.
* Work Environment: Plant locations may contain dust, fumes, debris, medium to loud levels of noise and extreme weather conditions including excessive heat or cold and rain prevalent at times. Travel may be required to other locations, site facilities or educational seminars. Typical office environment with adequate temperatures and lighting, low levels of noise.

$135,833.33 - $190,166.67

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all day-to-day manufacturing operations at the site, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production. The Plant Manager drives operational discipline, team performance, and continuous improvement to deliver consistent, predictable results.

  

**Company Overview:**

PTA Plastics, an employee-owned and innovative leader in the plastic injection molding, contract manufacturing and tool-building industry, is looking for a Plant Manager to join our dynamic team.

At PTA Plastics, we’re more than just a manufacturer; we partner with Fortune 500 OEMs in the medical device, defense, homeland security, and technology sectors, constantly pushing the boundaries of product development and manufacturing excellence. As an employee-owned company, every team member has a stake in our success, creating a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where innovation thrives.

**Pay:** $150,000 - $190,000 annually

  

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Site P&L Performance**

* Own site-level financial performance

* Deliver budgeted profitability, labor efficiency, and cost targets

* Control overtime, scrap, and operating expenses

  

**Production & Operational Execution**

* Lead all day-to-day plant operations

* Ensure schedule attainment and on-time delivery

* Drive production efficiency, uptime, and throughput

* Remove operational roadblocks quickly

* Lead and resolve customer escalations at the plant level

  

**Safety & Compliance**

* Own plant safety performance

* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental, and company standards

* Drive a proactive, behavior-based safety culture

  

**People Leadership & Culture**

* Lead and develop plant leadership team and floor personnel

* Drive accountability, performance management, and clear expectations

* Build a high-performance, no-excuses culture

  

**Execution of Corporate Quality Standards**

* Ensure adherence to corporate Quality Management System (QMS)

* Support and enforce corrective actions

* Hold production teams accountable for quality at the source

  

**Execution of Corporate Engineering Standards**

* Maintain schedule discipline and production alignment with planning

* Resolve plant-level material and supply issues

* Support inventory control and flow

  

**Cross Functional Alignment**

* Corporate Quality

* Corporate Engineering

* Corporate Supply Chain

* Corporate HR

  

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean and continuous improvement initiatives

* Reduce scrap, downtime, and inefficiencies

* Improve labor utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)

  

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

#### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field required (or equivalent combination of education and experience)
* 7–10+ years of manufacturing experience, preferably in injection molding or a similar high-volume, process-driven environment
* 3–5+ years of leadership experience managing production teams and plant operations
* Proven track record of delivering results in:
  + Production output and schedule attainment
  + Cost control and labor efficiency
  + Safety and quality performance
* Experience leading in a metrics-driven environment (OEE, scrap, uptime, etc.)
* Hands-on experience with Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and waste reduction initiatives
* Experience working within structured corporate environments with cross-functional support (Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, HR)
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and production planning processes

#### **Technical & Industry Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, including production processes, workflow optimization, and plant performance metrics (OEE, uptime, scrap, labor efficiency)

* Working knowledge of injection molding processes, materials, tooling, and secondary operations (or similar high-volume manufacturing processes)

* Understanding of maintenance and reliability principles, including preventive maintenance and equipment uptime optimization

* Experience with Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and waste reduction methodologies (5S, Kaizen, standard work, etc.)

* Knowledge of quality systems and practices, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and adherence to QMS standards (ISO or similar)

* Familiarity with production scheduling, capacity planning, and inventory flow within an ERP/MRP environment

* Understanding of workplace safety standards and regulatory compliance (OSHA, environmental requirements)

* Ability to interpret and act on operational data to drive performance improvements

  

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to stand, walk, and move around the production floor for extended periods.
* Capable of lifting and carrying heavy objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination for handling small tools, machine components, and molds.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Comfortable wearing personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, gloves, and ear protection.
* Occasional bending, kneeling, and reaching to access equipment and perform maintenance tasks.
* Good vision and color perception for inspecting parts and identifying any defects or abnormalities.
* Ability to work in temperature-controlled environments and withstand exposure to noise levels associated with manufacturing machinery.
* Ability to receive, comprehend and utilize required training from OSHA and Company including but not limited to the following:
* Hazard Communication
* Lock Out/Tag Out

  

**ITAR Requirements:** To conform to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3), applicants for employment at PTA Plastics must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawfully admitted for permanent residence into the U.S. (i.e., current green card holder), or lawfully admitted as a refugee or granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1157-1158.

Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with applicable laws to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job duties.

Headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana, Dexter has manufacturing and distribution locations throughout the U.S. and Canada. Employing state-of-the-art robotics, precision welding equipment, and automated machining processes, Dexter has achieved over 65 years of success through a commitment to the principles of superior quality, continuous improvement, and unparalleled customer service.

For more information about our company, access Dexter's web site at www.dextergroup.com.

* Continuously promotes and grows a culture of Safety.
* Drives commitment to quality throughout the operation, assuring excellence in customer service.
* Promotes an environment of trust, employee involvement, and engagement.
* Provides direction, leadership, and development to managers and supervisors.
* Develops annual budget, monthly forecasts, and gap analysis of financial performance.
* Budgets and manages capital expenditures.
* Champions continuous improvement.
* Develops plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality.

* Lead and drive the success of the health, safety, quality, and financial performance of the plant.

* Foster plant Safety, Quality and Production successes along with continuous improvement to create new ways in which to operate the business better.
* Foster and develop an environment of Zero Accidents.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The PE Quality Control Head of Department (HOD) is responsible for leading the company's overall quality management function across internal manufacturing processes, suppliers, outsourcing partners, and OEM customers for MOBIS North America Electrified Powertrain, LLC. (MNAe). Reporting to both the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Quality Control Head of Group (HOG), the HOD establishes quality strategy, objectives, governance, and priorities; oversees MIP process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production; leads major investigations and escalations; and ensures that containment, root cause, corrective action, and effectiveness verification are completed to protect customers, stabilize production, and prevent recurrence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *(To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

* Represent the Quality Control function in executive reviews, customer meetings, supplier escalations, audits, and other strategic business discussions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.
* Plan and oversee internal, supplier, customer, and certification audits and ensure timely closure and effectiveness of follow-up actions.
* Lead cross-functional quality decisions and collaboration with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.
* Report quality performance, significant risks, customer and supplier escalations, resource needs, and recovery status directly to the CEO and executive management.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and lead quality communication, claims, audits, investigations, corrective action submissions, and escalation response.
* Maintain management-level communication with outsourcing partners and OEM customers regarding ICCU and HPCU production quality performance, major issues, investigation results, corrective action status, and quality recovery plans.
* Communicate directly with suppliers and oversee supplier quality activities, including supplier containment, investigation, corrective action, response status, escalation, and closure.
* Oversee containment, affected-scope determination, traceability, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification.
* Ensure issues are properly classified as internal process, supplier, design, logistics, or customer-interface related and assign clear ownership for resolution.
* Lead and approve major investigations involving internal defects, supplier-related issues, customer complaints, field concerns, and quality escalations.
* Direct MIP process quality, supplier quality, and customer quality activities across Stator, Motor, Reducer, PE System, Inverter, and related electrified powertrain products.
* Direct overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production, including outsourcing-partner performance, process controls, change points, audits, defect trends, containment, corrective actions, escalation, and effectiveness verification.
* Establish and execute departmental quality strategy, objectives, policies, governance, priorities, and performance indicators aligned with company business objectives.
* Lead the company's overall quality management activities covering internal manufacturing processes, supplied components, finished products, and OEM customer interfaces.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
* Working knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, audit management, traceability, containment, and change control.
* Ability to prioritize multiple critical issues, assign ownership, allocate resources, and drive timely closure under production and customer pressure.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and escalation-management skills for interaction with the CEO, executive management, OEM customers, suppliers, and cross-functional leaders.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, and corrective action effectiveness verification.
* Ability to evaluate complex quality risks from company-wide, customer, supplier, financial, operational, and business-continuity perspectives.
* Broad working knowledge of internal process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, quality systems, and automotive manufacturing operations.
* Strong executive leadership, organizational management, people development, and decision-making capabilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.

***AUTHORITYSCOPE***

Yes. Provides overall leadership and direction for the PE Quality Control Department, including MIP process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality activities. Supervises assigned quality leaders and personnel and is responsible for work direction, priority setting, resource allocation, coaching, performance feedback, organizational capability, and escalation management in accordance with company policy.

***QUALIFICATIONS***

**Required EducationExperience:**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution.
* Five (5) years of leadership experience managing quality teams, cross-functional investigations, and major customer and/or supplier escalations.

existing_roles.description:
**Description**

  
  
  
  

Title: Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS)  
Department: EHSQ / Quality  
Location: Houston, TX

Supervisor: Sr. Director of Quality  
Direct Reports: None  
FLSA Status: Exempt  
Position Status: Permanent, Full-time

Work Status (Remote/Hybrid/In-Office): Remote

Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS)

Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (“HQC US”) develops, invests, and delivers solar photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage systems (BESS) projects through Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) services in North America.

The company brings a decade of global leadership in solar PV to deliver utility-scale power generation plants customized for local and regional energy markets. HQC US offers the full spectrum of PV solutions – from the core technology of cells and modules to large-scale project development and investment. With proven capabilities across the solar and battery storage chain, HQC US minimizes uncertainty and risk, and helps customers achieve a higher return on their investment in renewable energy.

SUMMARY

The Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS) (“Quality SME”) serves as the company’s subject matter expert and technical authority for Quality on Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) construction. The Quality SME is responsible for developing and maintaining the processes, systems, Inspection & Test Plan (ITP) templates, Quality Control Verification Checklists, and Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) that govern how Quality is planned, executed, and documented on BESS scopes, whether self-performed or subcontracted. The role covers both standalone BESS facilities and BESS integrated with utility-scale solar PV projects.

The Quality SME works alongside the Regional Quality Managers on every project with active BESS construction, integrating discipline requirements into the project Quality program and providing technical direction to the Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors hired for these scopes. Those personnel report to the assigned Site Quality Manager or Sr. Site Quality Manager, who remains the single point of contact and the ranking Quality authority on site. The Quality SME holds a matrixed line of technical direction to the discipline team, participates in hiring, onboarding, training, and performance input, and is accountable for the technical consistency, process discipline, and record integrity of BESS Quality across the portfolio.

Success in this role requires deep practical knowledge of utility-scale BESS construction, including equipment foundations and anchorage, battery enclosures and containers, power conversion systems (PCS) and inverters, medium-voltage transformers, auxiliary power, DC and AC cabling and terminations, grounding and bonding, thermal management systems, and fire detection, suppression, gas detection, and explosion control installation interfaces. Equally important is a working command of manufacturer-specific installation, preservation, and warranty requirements, which often govern acceptance more directly than the project drawings. The Quality SME aligns closely with the Engineering and BESS teams to integrate Quality early and resolve technical questions consistently. Design interpretation, battery management and energy management system configuration, functional commissioning, and capacity testing remain with Engineering, Commissioning, and the manufacturer; the Quality SME ensures those interfaces are defined, documented, and respected.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director of Quality (or another designated member of senior management). The role is remote, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, or as site construction hours dictate during jobsite visits. Travel is required up to 50% of the time, which includes scheduled jobsite visits for oversight and technical authority, as well as short-notice trips and extended site visits as business needs dictate.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTION & RESPONSIBILITIES

  

* Serve as the company’s subject matter expert and technical authority for Quality on standalone and PV-integrated BESS construction, supporting the Senior Director of Quality and the Regional Quality Managers.
* Develop, own, and maintain company-standard ITP templates, Quality Control Verification Checklists, SWIs, and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) content for BESS scopes, ensuring they reflect current engineering standards, manufacturer requirements, and lessons learned.
* Build and maintain BESS inspection templates and workflows in Procore, in coordination with Quality Systems, so that discipline inspections are performed and recorded consistently across all projects.
* Integrate with the assigned Regional Quality Manager on each project containing BESS scope, from pre-mobilization planning through turnover, confirming discipline requirements are incorporated into the Site-Specific Quality Management Plan (SSQMP), ITPs, inspection staffing plan, and inspection schedule.
* Support the Preconstruction Quality SME by tailoring discipline ITPs and checklists for project kickoff packages and identifying BESS-specific contract, manufacturer, testing, and authority having jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements.
* Provide technical direction to the BESS Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors assigned to projects, in coordination with the Site Quality Manager, who retains administrative supervision and day-to-day site direction.
* Participate in recruitment, technical interviewing, onboarding, and qualification of discipline Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors, and provide performance input to the Site Quality Manager and Regional Quality Manager.
* Develop and deliver discipline-specific training for Quality personnel, covering acceptance criteria, inspection methods, manufacturer requirements, documentation requirements, and common BESS failure modes.
* Conduct scheduled jobsite visits to verify implementation of the BESS Quality program, perform surveillance of field inspection activities, and audit discipline records in Procore for accuracy, completeness, traceability, and objective evidence.
* Provide technical review and approval of subcontractor Quality Control Plans, ITPs, and inspection forms for BESS scopes prior to acceptance by the Site Quality Manager, and verify subcontractor Quality performance through surveillance and audit.
* Provide technical review and concurrence on proposed repair and use-as-is dispositions for nonconformances within the discipline, and on other dispositions as requested by the Site Quality Manager, in coordination with Engineering and the manufacturer.
* Lead or support root cause analysis for significant or recurring BESS nonconformances, and drive corrective and preventive actions to closure across the portfolio.
* Exercise stop-work authority for quality-driven conditions in accordance with company policy, coordinating through the Site Quality Manager as the single point of contact on site.
* Elevate unresolved technical disagreements with site Quality, Construction, subcontractor, or manufacturer personnel to the Regional Quality Manager and Senior Director of Quality, with a documented position and recommended resolution.
* Define Quality’s verification requirements for receiving, storage, preservation, handling, and installation of BESS equipment, including manufacturer limits on storage conditions, storage duration, and state-of-charge maintenance that affect product conformity and warranty.
* Verify that manufacturer installation checklists, field service requirements, and warranty-related documentation are integrated into ITPs and completed in sequence, and coordinate Quality activities with manufacturer field representatives.
* Review pre-commissioning and construction test records, including torque verification, insulation resistance, and continuity testing, for completeness and conformance with project specifications, manufacturer requirements, and ANSI/NETA ATS where applicable.
* Define and support Quality’s responsibilities within the functional testing and cold commissioning RACI and in mechanical completion, energization-readiness, and turnover verification for BESS systems, while maintaining clear separation from battery management system configuration, functional commissioning, and capacity testing responsibilities.
* Where required by contract and as directed by the Senior Director of Quality, support factory acceptance test (FAT) witnessing and source inspection of BESS enclosures, PCS, and transformers, and contribute to the development of a formal source inspection program as the organization establishes one.
* Coordinate with owner’s engineers, independent engineers, AHJs, fire officials, and third-party agencies on BESS Quality matters, including inspection and documentation requirements associated with fire and life-safety systems.
* Align closely with the Engineering and BESS teams to resolve technical questions, participate in design and constructability reviews, and maintain consistent acceptance criteria across projects and manufacturers.
* Monitor BESS Quality KPIs and nonconformance trends across the portfolio, and report findings, emerging risks, and recommendations to the Senior Director of Quality.
* Provide input on discipline staffing and resource planning, including the number and qualification of Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors and third-party testing needs, for estimating and project staffing plans.
* Define the BESS Quality records required for turnover and verify completeness of discipline turnover documentation, including manufacturer and warranty records.
* Capture lessons learned from executed projects and incorporate them into discipline templates, training, and the broader Quality Management System (QMS).
* Interact and collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, BESS, Construction, Commissioning, Subcontract Management, and Safety teams to embed Quality into project execution.
* Perform other duties and special projects, as assigned.
* Travel is required up to 50%, including scheduled jobsite visits, extended site visits, short-notice trips, and overnight stays.

KEY COMPETENCIES / CORE SKILLS

  

* Recognized technical authority who guides others through credibility and clear reasoning rather than positional authority.
* Translates engineering, manufacturer, code, and contract requirements into clear, inspectable acceptance criteria.
* Builds standardized tools, including ITPs, checklists, SWIs, and Procore templates, that scale across projects, manufacturers, and delivery models.
* Leads effectively within a matrixed structure, supporting the Site Quality Manager as the single point of contact while holding the technical standard for the discipline.
* Holds the standard under schedule and commercial pressure while maintaining professional, collaborative working relationships with project teams and manufacturers.
* Understands the boundaries between construction Quality, Engineering, manufacturer responsibilities, and Commissioning, and escalates appropriately.
* Maintains exceptional attention to detail across inspection records, preservation records, test reports, and supporting objective evidence.
* Analyzes deficiency trends across the portfolio and translates findings into durable process change.
* Communicates clearly and factually with field personnel, engineers, manufacturers, owners, AHJs, and executive leadership, both in writing and in person.
* Coaches and develops discipline Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors, treating development of the bench as a core responsibility.
* Manages multiple concurrent projects, travel demands, and shifting priorities while maintaining accountability.
* Maintains composure and a solutions-focused approach under pressure, disagreement, and challenging field conditions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive quality experience in utility-scale renewable-energy, utility, or industrial construction, including at least 5 years of direct Quality responsibility on utility-scale BESS projects; utility-scale PV experience alone does not satisfy this requirement.
* At least 5 years in a quality leadership or management role, including directing inspection personnel or leading Quality programs across multiple projects.
* Demonstrated experience authoring and maintaining ITPs, Quality Inspection Checklists, Standard Work Instructions, and procedures for BESS construction.
* Strong working knowledge of BESS construction, including equipment foundations and anchorage, battery enclosures and containers, PCS and inverter equipment, medium-voltage transformers, auxiliary systems, DC and AC cabling and terminations, grounding and bonding, thermal management systems, and fire detection and suppression installation interfaces.
* Demonstrated experience applying manufacturer-specific installation, preservation, and warranty requirements for utility-scale energy storage equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to read and apply IFC drawings, single-line diagrams, equipment layouts, grounding plans, cable schedules, specifications, approved submittals, and manufacturer installation manuals.
* Experience overseeing Quality on both self-performed and subcontracted BESS work, including review of subcontractor Quality Control Plans and ITPs.
* Experience coordinating Quality activities with manufacturer field representatives, owner’s engineers, independent engineers, testing agencies, and AHJs.
* Demonstrated experience with nonconformance management, root cause analysis methodology (5-Why, fishbone, fault tree, or equivalent), and corrective action programs.
* Demonstrated understanding of the boundaries between construction Quality, Engineering, manufacturer, and Commissioning responsibilities.
* Proficiency with Procore (Quality & Field Management modules) and SharePoint.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work remotely with a reliable high-speed internet connection and flexibility to support projects across Eastern through Pacific Time Zones as required.
* Must hold and maintain a valid U.S. driver’s license and have the ability to safely operate a motor vehicle, including the ability to rent vehicles for business travel without restrictions that would interfere with job performance.
* Ability to successfully pass a motor vehicle/driving record background check in accordance with company policy.
* Must be able to pass pre-employment, regular, and random drug and alcohol screenings in compliance with company and customer requirements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
